name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.measurable_enlargedFunction
OAI.ExactModuli.KW.resampling_difference
statement:
lemma resampling_difference [MeasurableSpace B] [DecidableEq κ]
    (p : ℝ) (x : B → ℝ) (u : κ → B → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ)
    (k : κ) (z : B × (κ → ι → unitInterval × unitInterval)) :
    enlargedFunction p x u a (z.1, selectRows (fun _ => false) z.2) -
      enlargedFunction p x u a (z.1, selectRows (fun l => decide (l = k)) z.2) =
    u k z.1 * diffRowSum p (a k) (z.2 k)

    ∃ c : ℝ, (cubeMeasure ι).real {v | r < |rowSum p a v - c|} < q

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.near_additivity
statement:
lemma near_additivity {R : Type uR} [MeasurableSpace R] {ν : Measure R}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {w u : B → ℝ} {f : R → ℝ}
    (hw : Integrable w μ) (hu : Integrable u μ) (hf : Integrable f ν)
    (hfm : Measurable f) (hf0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ f v)
    (hw1 : ∫ b, |w b| ∂μ = 1) (hu1 : ∫ b, |u b| ∂μ = 1)
    (hf1 : ∫ v, f v ∂ν = 1) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    2 - 2 * (ν.real {v | c < f v} + c) ≤
      ∫ z : B × R, |w z.1 + u z.1 * f z.2| ∂(μ.prod ν)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.normalizeFunction_bounds
statement:
lemma normalizeFunction_bounds [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f : B → ℝ} (_hf : Integrable f μ) {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hN : (∫ b, |f b| ∂μ) ≤ R) :
    (∫ b, |normalizeFunction μ f b| ∂μ) ≤ 1 ∧
    (∫ b, |f b - normalizeFunction μ f b| ∂μ) ≤ R - 1

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.old_norm_on_good_set
statement:
lemma old_norm_on_good_set {R : Type uR} [MeasurableSpace R] {ν : Measure R}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {g : B × R → ℝ} {ψ U : B → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g (μ.prod ν)) (hψ : Integrable ψ μ) (hU : Integrable U μ)
    (_hU0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ U b) {m r : ℝ} (hm : ∫ b, U b ∂μ = m) (_hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hg1 : ∫ z, |g z| ∂(μ.prod ν) ≤ 1)
    {D : Set R} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hDpos : 0 < ν.real D)
    (hgood : ∀ b v, v ∈ D → |g (b, v) - ψ b| ≤ r * U b) :
    (∫ b, |ψ b| ∂μ) ≤ r * m + 1 / ν.real D

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.restricted_markov
statement:
lemma restricted_markov {R : Type uR} [MeasurableSpace R] {ν : Measure R}
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f b : R → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) (hb : Integrable b ν)
    (hf0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ f v) (hb0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ b v)
    {D : Set R} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hdom : ∀ v ∈ D, f v ≤ b v)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ν.real {v | h < f v} ≤ ν.real Dᶜ + (∫ v, b v ∂ν) / h

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.enlargement_parameters
statement:
lemma enlargement_parameters {m h : ℝ} (_hm : 0 < m) (hh : 0 < h) (_hh1 : h < 1) :
    ∃ c r q p : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ c < h / 4 ∧ 0 < r ∧ 0 < q ∧ 1 < p ∧ p ≤ 3/2 ∧
      m * q < 1 ∧ m * q + h⁻¹ * (2 * m * r + (1 - m * q)⁻¹ - 1) < h ∧
      scale p < c ∧ 2 * ((scale p / c) ^ p + c) < h ∧ 10 * (108 * scale p / r) ^ p < q

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.integrable_oldCombination
OAI.ExactModuli.KW.whole_ball_estimate
statement:
lemma whole_ball_estimate {R : Type uR} [MeasurableSpace R] {ν : Measure R}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {g : B × R → ℝ} {ψ U : B → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g (μ.prod ν)) (hψ : Integrable ψ μ) (hU : Integrable U μ)
    (hU0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ U b) {m r q h : ℝ} (hm : ∫ b, U b ∂μ = m)
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ m) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hmq : m * q < 1) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hg1 : ∫ z, |g z| ∂(μ.prod ν) ≤ 1)
    {D : Set R} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hDprob : 1 - m * q ≤ ν.real D)
    (hgood : ∀ b v, v ∈ D → |g (b, v) - ψ b| ≤ r * U b) :
    (∫ b, |normalizeFunction μ ψ b| ∂μ) ≤ 1 ∧
    (μ.prod ν).real {z | h < |g z - normalizeFunction μ ψ z.1|} ≤
      m * q + h⁻¹ * (2 * m * r + (1 - m * q)⁻¹ - 1)

    ‖oldL1 u - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j : Fin n, atomL1 hp u k j‖ =

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.joint_budget
statement:
lemma joint_budget (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω,0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω,w ω=1)
    (I : Ω → Type*) [∀ ω,Fintype (I ω)] (a b : ∀ ω,I ω→ℝ) {r R : ℝ}
    (he : ∀ ω,(∑ i,a ω i^2) ≤ R^2)
    (hc : (∑ ω,w ω*(∑ i,a ω i*b ω i)) = r^2) :
    (∑ ω,w ω*(∑ i,(a ω i-b ω i)^2)) +
      (∑ ω,w ω*(r^2-∑ i,b ω i^2)) ≤ R^2-r^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.norm_mean_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma norm_mean_le_sqrt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω,w ω = 1)
    (z : Ω → E) {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hz : (∑ ω, w ω * ‖z ω‖ ^ 2) ≤ V) :
    ‖∑ ω, w ω • z ω‖ ≤ Real.sqrt V

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.pooled_mass
statement:
lemma pooled_mass {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω,w ω = 1)
    (b W : Ω → κ → ℝ) (V L : Ω → ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ g, (∑ ω,w ω*b ω g) = -(∑ ω,w ω*W ω g))
    (hW : ∀ ω, (∑ g,W ω g ^ 2) ≤ V ω)
    (hopp : ∀ ω ν, (∑ g, (|b ω g| * |b ν g| - b ω g*b ν g)) ≤ L ω + L ν) :
    (∑ g, (∑ ω,w ω* |b ω g|)^2) ≤ (∑ ω,w ω*V ω) + 2*(∑ ω,w ω*L ω)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.sqrt_pooled
statement:
lemma sqrt_pooled {η θ : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    Real.sqrt η + Real.sqrt (η+2*θ) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (η+θ)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.sum_mul_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_mul_sq_le (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.primal_le_l1

statement:
lemma crossing_cut_sum {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)

    (hfirst : A.first F i ≤ A.first G j) :
    (∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (fun v => A.first G j ≤ v), p v) =
      ∑ v ∈ G.seg j, p v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.exists_gate_le

statement:
lemma finite_heads_of_predecessors

lemma first_le_of_mem (F : A.segments.Family) (i : Fin F.n) {v : ι}

statement:
lemma gate_on_nonzero_segment {H K : Finset ι} (hH : A.Ancestral (H : Set ι))

    (i : Fin F.n) (hi : (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ≠ 0) {v : ι}
    (hvi : v ∈ F.seg i) (hvH : v ∉ H) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.gate_unique_in_segment
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.gates_eq_of_common_upper

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.interval_chain
statement:
lemma interval_chain {S : Finset ι} (hS : A.segments.IsSegment S) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.localize_family_energy
statement:
lemma localize_family_energy {K : Finset ι} (hK : A.Ancestral (K : Set ι))
    (F : A.segments.Family) (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ K → p v = 0) :
    ∃ G : A.segments.LocalFamily K,
      (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) =
        ∑ S : A.segments.LocalIndex G, (∑ v ∈ S.val, p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.matched_split_gain_le
statement:
lemma matched_split_gain_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (F : A.segments.Family) (e : κ ↪ Fin F.n) (c : κ → ι) (p : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) +
      2 * (∑ a, ((∑ v ∈ (F.seg (e a)).filter (fun v => c a ≤ v), p v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ F.seg (e a), p v) *
          (∑ v ∈ (F.seg (e a)).filter (fun v => c a ≤ v), p v))) ≤
      (A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.mem_gateSet
statement:
lemma mem_gateSet {H K : Finset ι} {g : ι} :
    g ∈ A.gateSet H K ↔ g ∈ K ∧ A.Gate (H : Set ι) g

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.opposite_crossing_le
statement:
lemma opposite_crossing_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ H → p v = 0) (F G : A.segments.Family)
    (gate : κ ↪ ι) (hgate : ∀ a, A.Gate H (gate a)) :
    (∑ a, (|A.boundaryCoeff F p (gate a)| * |A.boundaryCoeff G p (gate a)| -
      A.boundaryCoeff F p (gate a) * A.boundaryCoeff G p (gate a))) ≤
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) +
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ G.seg j, p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.opposite_matching_le
statement:
lemma opposite_matching_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ H → p v = 0) (F G : A.segments.Family)
    (eF : κ ↪ Fin F.n) (eG : κ ↪ Fin G.n) (g : κ → ι)
    (hgH : ∀ a, g a ∉ H) (hgF : ∀ a, g a ∈ F.seg (eF a))
    (hgG : ∀ a, g a ∈ G.seg (eG a))
    (hopp : ∀ a, (∑ v ∈ F.seg (eF a), p v) * (∑ v ∈ G.seg (eG a), p v) < 0) :
    2 * (∑ a, |(∑ v ∈ F.seg (eF a), p v) * (∑ v ∈ G.seg (eG a), p v)|) ≤
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) +
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ G.seg j, p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.primal_filter_le
statement:
lemma primal_filter_le {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    A.segments.primalSeminorm (u.filter (· ∈ H)) ≤ A.segments.primalSeminorm u

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.primal_filter_tail_le
statement:
lemma primal_filter_tail_le {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.primal_le_of_local_energies
statement:
lemma primal_le_of_local_energies {K : Finset ι} (hK : A.Ancestral (K : Set ι))
    (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ K → p v = 0) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hlocal : ∀ G : A.segments.LocalFamily K,
      (∑ S : A.segments.LocalIndex G, (∑ v ∈ S.val, p v) ^ 2) ≤ M ^ 2) :
    A.segments.primalSeminorm p ≤ M

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.segment_filter_head
statement:
lemma segment_filter_head {S : Finset ι} (hS : A.segments.IsSegment S)
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) :
    (S.filter (· ∈ H)).Nonempty → A.segments.IsSegment (S.filter (· ∈ H))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.segment_filter_tail
statement:
lemma segment_filter_tail {S : Finset ι} (hS : A.segments.IsSegment S)

    (S.filter (· ∉ H)).Nonempty → A.segments.IsSegment (S.filter (· ∉ H))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.split_energy_le
statement:
lemma split_energy_le (F : A.segments.Family) (H : Fin F.n → Set ι)
    (hH : ∀ i, A.Ancestral (H i)) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ((∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∈ H i), u v) ^ 2 +
      (∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H i), u v) ^ 2)) ≤
      (A.segments.primalSeminorm u) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.split_gain_le
statement:
lemma split_gain_le (F : A.segments.Family) (H : Fin F.n → Set ι)
    (hH : ∀ i, A.Ancestral (H i)) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, u v) ^ 2) +
      2 * (∑ i : Fin F.n, ((∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H i), u v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, u v) * (∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H i), u v))) ≤
        (A.segments.primalSeminorm u) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.sum_extend_zero

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.finite_square_tails
OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.primal_sq_le

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_old
statement:
lemma distance_old (n : ℕ) (u v : Vertex n) :
    distance (n+1) (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v)=distance n u v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_potential
statement:
lemma distance_potential (n : ℕ) (a : Vertex n) :
    ∀ u v,(graph n).Adj u v →
      |((graph n).dist a u : ℝ)-(graph n).dist a v| ≤ 1

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_siblings
statement:
lemma distance_siblings (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    distance (n+1) (Sum.inr (e,i)) (Sum.inr (e,j))=2/(2:ℝ)^(n+1)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distortion_bound
statement:
lemma distortion_bound (hX : QuadraticLens X) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    (D s : ℝ) (h : HasDistortion k f D s) : 1+(k:ℝ)/4 ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.endpoint_ne
statement: lemma endpoint_ne (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) : endpoint n e false ≠ endpoint n e true

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.extendPotential_adj
statement:
lemma extendPotential_adj {n : ℕ} (φ : Vertex n → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ u v,(graph n).Adj u v → |φ u-φ v| ≤ 1) :
    ∀ u v,(graph (n+1)).Adj u v → |extendPotential φ u-extendPotential φ v| ≤ 1

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.not_adj_new
statement:
lemma not_adj_new {n : ℕ} (u v : Edge n × ℕ) :
    ¬(graph (n+1)).Adj (Sum.inr u) (Sum.inr v)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.not_adj_old
statement:
lemma not_adj_old {n : ℕ} (u v : Vertex n) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.potential_walk
statement:
lemma potential_walk {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} (φ : V → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ u v,G.Adj u v → |φ u-φ v| ≤ 1) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    |φ u-φ v| ≤ p.length

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.replace_adj
statement:
lemma replace_adj {n : ℕ} {u v : Vertex n} (h : (graph n).Adj u v) :
    ∃ p : (graph (n+1)).Walk (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v), p.length=2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.replace_walk
statement:
lemma replace_walk {n : ℕ} {u v : Vertex n} (p : (graph n).Walk u v) :
    ∃ q : (graph (n+1)).Walk (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v),q.length=2*p.length

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.slope_minus_deviation
statement:
lemma slope_minus_deviation {n : ℕ} (f : Vertex (n+1) → X) (e : Edge n) (i : ℕ) :
    slope (fun v => f (Sum.inl v)) e-deviation f e i=slope f (e,i,true)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.slope_plus_deviation
statement:
lemma slope_plus_deviation {n : ℕ} (f : Vertex (n+1) → X) (e : Edge n) (i : ℕ) :
    slope (fun v => f (Sum.inl v)) e+deviation f e i=slope f (e,i,false)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.iterate_additive
statement:
lemma iterate_additive {s D δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hstep : ∀ (x : X) (z : ℕ → X) (R : ℝ),0 ≤ R → R ≤ D → s ≤ ‖x‖ →
      (∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) → (∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R) →
      (∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2*s ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) → ‖x‖ ≤ R-δ)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLD : L ≤ D)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hb : ∀ e,‖slope f e‖ ≤ L) : s+(k:ℝ)*δ ≤ L

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.iterate_contraction

      (∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) → (∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R) →
      (∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2*s ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) → ‖x‖ ≤ c*R)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLD : L ≤ D)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hb : ∀ e,‖slope f e‖ ≤ L) : s ≤ c^k*L

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.parametric_lens
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.pure_pair
statement:
lemma Heads.pure_pair (A : Heads ι X) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) {R ε η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ (H : ι) (p y : X),A.projection H p=p ∧ A.projection H y=0 ∧
      ‖x‖-η ≤ ‖p‖ ∧ ε/2-η ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖p+y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖p-y‖ ≤ R+2*η

    ∃ i j : ℕ,i ≠ j ∧ ‖P ((1/2:ℝ) • (z i-z j))‖ < η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.pair_errors
statement:
lemma pair_errors (P : X →L[ℝ] X)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap)]
    {x p : X} (z : ℕ → X) {R ε η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hclose : ‖x-p‖ < η) (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ i j : ℕ,i ≠ j ∧
      let w := (1/2:ℝ) • (z i-z j)
      let y := w-P w
      ‖P w‖ < η ∧ ε/2-η ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖x‖-η ≤ ‖p‖ ∧
        ‖p+y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖p-y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖x+w‖ ≤ R ∧ ‖x-w‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.finite_tail_approx
statement:
lemma Heads.finite_tail_approx (A : Heads ι X) (hcomm : A.Commutes)
    (H : ι) {y : X} (hY : A.projection H y=0) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ v : X,A.FiniteVector v ∧ A.projection H v=0 ∧ ‖y-v‖ < η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.weak_pure
statement:
lemma Heads.weak_pure (A : Heads ι X) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hz : WeaklyNull z)
    {R ε η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hl : ∀ i,ε ≤ ‖z i‖)
    (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R) :
    ∃ (H : ι) (p y : X),A.projection H p=p ∧ A.projection H y=0 ∧
      ‖x‖-η ≤ ‖p‖ ∧ ε-η ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖p+y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖p-y‖ ≤ R+2*η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.finite_dimensional_weak_null
statement:
lemma finite_dimensional_weak_null [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] (P : X →L[ℝ] Y)
    (z : ℕ → X) (hz : WeaklyNull z) :
    Tendsto (fun n => P (z n)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.finite_rank_weak_null
statement:
lemma finite_rank_weak_null (P : X →L[ℝ] X)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap)]
    (z : ℕ → X) (hz : WeaklyNull z) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ‖P (z n)‖) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveApplications.cubic_weak_lens
statement:
theorem cubic_weak_lens (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : CubicInput A) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (_hε1 : ε ≤ 1) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hz : WeaklyNull z)
    (hl : ∀ i,ε ≤ ‖z i‖) (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ theta ε

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveApplications.free_root_depth
statement:
theorem free_root_depth (A : Heads ι X) (hcomm : A.Commutes)
    {γ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} (hinput : FreeRootInput A γ) {D s : ℝ}
    (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    D⁻¹ ≤ (1-sumEta γ (2/D))^k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveApplications.free_root_lens
statement:
theorem free_root_lens (A : Heads ι X) (hcomm : A.Commutes)
    {γ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} (hinput : FreeRootInput A γ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Diamond.UnitLensBound X ε (1-sumEta γ ε)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveApplications.sumEta_range
statement:
lemma sumEta_range (A : Heads ι X) {γ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} (hinput : FreeRootInput A γ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : 0 < sumEta γ ε ∧ sumEta γ ε < 1

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveApplications.weak_power_lens
statement:
lemma weak_power_lens (A : Heads ι X) {n m : ℕ} {c ε : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hinput : PowerInput A n m c) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hz : WeaklyNull z)
    (hl : ∀ i,ε ≤ ‖z i‖) (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1-c*ε^n)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.arbitrary_tail_square
statement:
lemma arbitrary_tail_square (A : Heads ι X) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C)
    (hinput : ArbitraryTailInput A C) : A.SquareInput (1/C^2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.clipping_actual_child
statement:
lemma clipping_actual_child (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.ParametricInput (1/2) 4)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hxD : ‖x‖ ≤ D)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2 ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ i,‖x‖+clippingGamma D/(2*clippingQ D) < max ‖x+z i‖ ‖x-z i‖

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.clipping_bounds
statement:
lemma clipping_bounds {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    0 < clippingC D ∧ 1 ≤ clippingQ D ∧ clippingC D/4 ≤ clippingGamma D

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.component_sum
statement:
theorem component_sum (hinput : ComponentSumInput X) {D s e : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (he16 : e ≤ 1/16) (hsmall : 17*(2*e)^((1:ℝ)/6) < 1/(2*D))
    (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    (1+e/2)^k ≤ D

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.flow_square
statement:
lemma flow_square (A : Heads ι X) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hinput : FlowInput A B) :
    A.SquareInput (1/(2*B))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.incomparableK_gt_one
statement: lemma incomparableK_gt_one : 1 < incomparableK

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.incomparable_segments
statement:
theorem incomparable_segments (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.RadialInput incomparableK)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    D⁻¹ ≤ (1-(D⁻¹/incomparableK)^2)^k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.linearC_pos
statement: lemma linearC_pos : 0 < linearC

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.linear_clipping
statement:
theorem linear_clipping (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.ParametricInput (1/2) 4)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+(k:ℝ)*clippingGamma D/(2*clippingQ D) ≤ D

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.linear_flow
statement:
theorem linear_flow (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : FlowInput A (linearC^2))
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+(k:ℝ)/(2*linearC^2) ≤ D^2 ∧ (k:ℝ) ≤ 2*linearC^2*D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.linear_trimming
statement:
theorem linear_trimming (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : FlowInput A 242)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+(k:ℝ)/484 ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.quadratic_cost
statement:
theorem quadratic_cost (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : ArbitraryTailInput A 8)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+(k:ℝ)/64 ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.square_depth
statement:
lemma square_depth (A : Heads ι X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hinput : A.SquareInput a)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+a*(k:ℝ) ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.start_cost
statement:
theorem start_cost (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : StartInput A)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+(k:ℝ)/128 ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.start_square
statement: lemma start_square (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : StartInput A) : A.SquareInput (1/64)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.stopped_flow
statement:
theorem stopped_flow (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : StoppedInput A)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    (k:ℝ) ≤ 144*D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.tail_pruning
statement:
theorem tail_pruning (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : ArbitraryTailInput A 9)
    {D s γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ2 : γ < 1/2)
    (hparameter : 9*Real.sqrt ((1+γ)^2-(1-2*γ)^2) < 2*D⁻¹/3)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    D⁻¹ ≤ (1-γ)^k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.tail_seven
statement:
theorem tail_seven (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : ArbitraryTailInput A 7)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    D⁻¹ ≤ (1-(D⁻¹)^2/2000)^k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.unit_from_square
statement:
lemma unit_from_square {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] {b α ρ : ℝ} (hX : Diamond.SquareLens X b)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hgap : 1-b*(2*α)^2 ≤ ρ^2) :
    Diamond.UnitLensBound X (2*α) ρ

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.tail_packing
statement:
lemma tail_packing (P : X →L[ℝ] X) [FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap)]
    (z : ℕ → X) {R ε T : ℝ} (hz : ∀ i,‖z i‖ ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) (ht : ∀ i,‖z i-P (z i)‖ ≤ T) :
    ε/2 ≤ T

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.relative_actual_child
statement:
lemma relative_actual_child (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : RelativeInput A)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hx : 1 ≤ ‖x‖) (hxD : ‖x‖ ≤ D)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2 ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ i,(1+relativeDelta D)*‖x‖ < max ‖x+z i‖ ‖x-z i‖

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.relative_cost
statement:
theorem relative_cost (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : RelativeInput A)
    {D s : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (f : Diamond.Vertex k → X) (hf : Diamond.HasDistortion k f D s) :
    (1+relativeDelta D)^k ≤ D

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.relative_lens_impossible
statement:
lemma relative_lens_impossible (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : RelativeInput A)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hx : 1 ≤ ‖x‖) (hxD : ‖x‖ ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ (1+relativeDelta D)*‖x‖)
    (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ (1+relativeDelta D)*‖x‖)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2 ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) : False

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.PathApplications.relative_parameters
statement:
lemma relative_parameters {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    0 < relativeDelta D ∧ relativeDelta D ≤ 1 ∧ 72*Real.sqrt (relativeDelta D)*D < 1

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.CoordinateCompletion.Data.separates

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.aggregate_mono

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.aggregate_nonneg
statement: lemma aggregate_nonneg {ι : Type*} (p : ℝ≥0∞) (f : ι →₀ ℝ) : 0 ≤ aggregate p f

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.aggregate_smul
statement:
lemma aggregate_smul {ι : Type*} (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (c : ℝ) (f : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    aggregate p (c • f)=|c| * aggregate p f

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.aggregate_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma aggregate_zero {ι : Type*} (p : ℝ≥0∞) : aggregate p (0 : ι →₀ ℝ)=0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.ancestor_trans

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.components_apply

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.coordinate_le_aggregate

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.finiteLp_add

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.finiteLp_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma finiteLp_apply {ι : Type*} (p : ℝ≥0∞) (f : ι →₀ ℝ) (i : ι) : finiteLp p f i=f i

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.finiteLp_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma finiteLp_zero {ι : Type*} (p : ℝ≥0∞) : finiteLp p (0 : ι →₀ ℝ)=0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.forestQ_zero

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.forest_coordinate

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.forest_self_mem

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.join_add

lemma join_add (r s a b c d : ℝ) :
    (join (r+s) (a+c) (b+d)).1 ≤ (join r a b).1+(join s c d).1 ∧
    (join (r+s) (a+c) (b+d)).2 ≤ (join r a b).2+(join s c d).2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.join_mono

    (join r a b).1 ≤ (join r A B).1 ∧ (join r a b).2 ≤ (join r A B).2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.join_root_bound
statement:
lemma join_root_bound (r a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.join_smul
statement:
lemma join_smul (t r a b : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

lemma nu_add (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (h : ℕ) (v w : Vec h) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.nu_eq_zero

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.nu_zero

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.self_mem_ancestors

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.upper_add
statement:
lemma upper_add (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (h : ℕ) (v w : Vec h) :
    (upper p h (v+w)).1 ≤ (upper p h v).1+(upper p h w).1 ∧
    (upper p h (v+w)).2 ≤ (upper p h v).2+(upper p h w).2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.upper_child_bound

lemma upper_child_bound (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (h : ℕ) (v : Vec (h+1)) (i : ℕ) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.upper_smul_nonneg

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.upper_zero

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.vanishing_gap
statement:
lemma Heads.vanishing_gap (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.TailVanishing) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ ρ : ℝ,0 ≤ ρ ∧ ρ < 1 ∧
    ∀ x : X,(∀ η : ℝ,0 < η → ∃ (H : ι) (p y : X),
      A.projection H p=p ∧ A.projection H y=0 ∧
      ‖x‖-η ≤ ‖p‖ ∧ ε-η ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖p+y‖ ≤ 1+2*η ∧ ‖p-y‖ ≤ 1+2*η) → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.vanishing_lens
statement:
theorem Heads.vanishing_lens (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.TailVanishing) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ ρ : ℝ,0 ≤ ρ ∧ ρ < 1 ∧ Diamond.UnitLensBound X ε ρ

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.vanishing_obstruction
statement:
theorem Heads.vanishing_obstruction (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.TailVanishing) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.vanishing_weak
statement:
theorem Heads.vanishing_weak (A : Heads ι X) (hinput : A.TailVanishing) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ ρ : ℝ,0 ≤ ρ ∧ ρ < 1 ∧
    ∀ (x : X) (z : ℕ → X),WeaklyNull z → (∀ i,ε ≤ ‖z i‖) →
      (∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ 1) → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.numericalRange_nonempty
statement:
theorem numericalRange_nonempty {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.rangeMaximum_attained

theorem rangeMaximum_attained {n m d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_nonneg

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.positive_block_hsSq

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.isUnit_resolvent_of_not_mem

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.posSemidef_of_unit_quadratic

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.positive_resolvent
statement:
theorem positive_resolvent {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (z q : ℂ) (hz : z ∉ numericalRange A)
    (hs : ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A, 0 ≤ (star q * (z - w)).re) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_add
statement:
theorem quadratic_add {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic (A + B) u = quadratic A u + quadratic B u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_one
statement:
theorem quadratic_one {n : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic 1 u = (‖u‖ : ℂ) ^ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_smul
statement:
theorem quadratic_smul {n : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic (c • A) u = c * quadratic A u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_star
statement:
theorem quadratic_star {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_sub
statement:
theorem quadratic_sub {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic (A - B) u = quadratic A u - quadratic B u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_toLp
statement:
theorem quadratic_toLp {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : Fin n → ℂ) :
    quadratic A (WithLp.toLp 2 u) = star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_vector_smul
statement:
theorem quadratic_vector_smul {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) (c : ℂ) :
    quadratic A (c • u) = (star c * c) * quadratic A u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.resolvent_congruence
statement:
theorem resolvent_congruence {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hB : IsUnit B) (q : ℂ) :
    Bᴴ * ((q • B⁻¹) + (q • B⁻¹)ᴴ) * B = star q • B + q • Bᴴ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.supported_matrix_posSemidef
statement:
theorem supported_matrix_posSemidef {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (z q : ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A, 0 ≤ (star q * (z - w)).re) :
    (star q • (z • 1 - A) + q • (z • 1 - A)ᴴ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.exteriorKernel_nonneg_off_diagonal
statement:
theorem exteriorKernel_nonneg_off_diagonal (h q : ℂ → ℂ)
    {ζ μ : ℂ} (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1) (hμ : ‖μ‖ = 1) (hne : ζ ≠ μ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ (star (q ζ) * (h ζ - h μ)).re) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.kronecker_pow_one

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.re_circle_fraction

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_C

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_coefficientPolynomial

theorem tensorPolynomial_coefficientPolynomial {n m d : ℕ}

    (B : Fin (d + 1) → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_mul

theorem tensorPolynomial_mul {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)

    tensorPolynomial A (F * G) = tensorPolynomial A F * tensorPolynomial A G

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.entryPair_conj

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.entryPair_eq_inner

statement:
theorem anti_cross_energy {ι : Type u_82} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M L : BoundaryCircle → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hM : Continuous M) (hL : Continuous L)
    (hMp : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff M k = 0)
    (hLp : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff L k = 0)
    (hzero : (fourierCoeff L 0)ᴴ = fourierCoeff M 0) :
    (∫ t, hsSq (M t) ∂circleMeasure) ≤
      ∫ t, hsSq (M t + (L t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.anti_diagonal_energy
statement:
theorem anti_diagonal_energy {ι : Type u_81} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    (hpos : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff P k = 0)
    (hzero : (fourierCoeff P 0).IsHermitian) :
    (∫ t, hsSq (P t + (P t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure) =
      4 * (hsSq (fourierCoeff P 0) +
        (1/2 : ℝ) * ∑' n : ℕ, hsSq (fourierCoeff P (-(n+1))))

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.matrix_energy_split

theorem matrix_energy_split {ι : Type u_73} {κ : Type u_74} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.weighted_sequence_dual
statement:
theorem weighted_sequence_dual {ι : Type u_85} {κ : Type u_86} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

    (h : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix ι κ ℂ),

    hsSq (P 0) + (1/2 : ℝ) * ∑' n : ℕ, hsSq (P (n+1)) ≤ b

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.cross_boundary_estimate
statement:
theorem cross_boundary_estimate {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (G : MatrixPolynomial m) :
    ‖inner ℂ (hsVector Y) (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (tensorPolynomial A G) (hsVector X))‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∫ t, hsSq (Yᴴ * R t * X) ∂circleMeasure) * polynomialEnergy h G

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.faber_pairing
statement:
theorem faber_pairing {n m N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    inner ℂ (hsVector Y) (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (tensorPolynomial A (faberPolynomial b C)) (hsVector X)) =
      ∑ k : Fin N, entryPair (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b k) * X) (C k)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.singular_diagonal_estimates
statement:
theorem singular_diagonal_estimates {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (hupper : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C) ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (h t) F‖ ≤ 1)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hFx : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F) (hsVector X) =
      (γ : ℂ) • hsVector Y)
    (hFy : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F)) (hsVector Y) =
      (γ : ℂ) • hsVector X) :
    let a := ∫ t, hsSq (Yᴴ * R t * X) ∂circleMeasure
    (hsSq (Xᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b 0) * X) + (1/2 : ℝ) *
      ∑' k : ℕ, hsSq (Xᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b (k+1)) * X) ≤ a / γ^2) ∧
    (hsSq (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b 0) * Y) + (1/2 : ℝ) *
      ∑' k : ℕ, hsSq (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b (k+1)) * Y) ≤ a / γ^2)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.singular_ordered_pairings
statement:
theorem singular_ordered_pairings {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (F G : MatrixPolynomial m) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n × Fin m)) (γ : ℝ)
    (hFx : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F) x =
      (γ : ℂ) • y)
    (hFy : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F)) y =
      (γ : ℂ) • x) :
    inner ℂ y (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A (F * G)) x) =
      (γ : ℂ)
      * inner ℂ x (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A G) x) ∧
    inner ℂ y (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A (G * F)) x) =
      (γ : ℂ)
      * inner ℂ y (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A G) y)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_faber

theorem tensorPolynomial_faber {n m N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.analytic_domain_core
statement:
theorem analytic_domain_core {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (hb0 : b 0 = 1)
    (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (hupper : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C) ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (hposfreq : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff R k = 0)
    (hpositive : ∀ t, (R t + (R t)ᴴ).PosSemidef)
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (h t) F‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖ ≤ 2

statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_correction_left {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)

statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_correction_right {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.chordDenominator_diagonal
statement:
theorem chordDenominator_diagonal {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) (c : ℂ) {u : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) :
    chordDenominator c g u u = c-u^2*deriv g u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.chordDenominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chordDenominator_ne_zero {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hinj : InjOn (exterior c g) (Inv.inv ⁻¹' s \ {0}))
    (hd : ∀ ζ, ζ ≠ 0 → ζ⁻¹ ∈ s → deriv (exterior c g) ζ ≠ 0)
    {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) : chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.chordDenominator_off_diagonal
statement:
theorem chordDenominator_off_diagonal {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) (c : ℂ) {u v : ℂ}
    (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) (hu0 : u ≠ 0) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    chordDenominator c g u v = (exterior c g u⁻¹ - exterior c g v⁻¹) / (u⁻¹-v⁻¹)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.continuousOn_correction
statement:
theorem continuousOn_correction {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {c : ℂ}
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ s, ∀ v ∈ s, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => correction c g p.1 p.2) (s ×ˢ s)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.correction_identity
statement:
theorem correction_identity {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) (c : ℂ) {u v : ℂ}
    (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (hH : chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) :
    correction c g u v = (c-u^2*deriv g u)/(c+u*(g u-exterior c g v⁻¹)) - (1-u/v)⁻¹

statement: @[simp] theorem correction_zero_right (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℂ) : correction c g u 0 = 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.divided_derivative_relation
statement:
theorem divided_derivative_relation {s : Set ℂ} (hs : IsOpen s) (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) :
    divided g u v + (u-v)*dividedLeft g u v = deriv g u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.divided_eq_dslope
statement:
theorem divided_eq_dslope {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)

    divided g u v = dslope g v u

statement:
theorem divided_fundamental {s : Set ℂ} (hconv : Convex ℝ s)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g s) {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) :
    (u-v)*divided g u v = g u-g v

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.fourierCoeff_of_analytic
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_of_analytic {E : Type u_105} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball 0 R)) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => f (unitPoint t)) k =
      if 0 ≤ k then taylorCoeff f k.toNat else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.fourierCoeff_of_powerSeries
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_of_powerSeries {E : Type u_104} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ E} {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hp : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f p 0 r) (hr : 1 < r) (k : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => f (unitPoint t)) k =
      if 0 ≤ k then taylorCoeff f k.toNat else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.integral_character_smul
statement:
theorem integral_character_smul {E : Type u_103} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (a b : ℤ) (v : E) :
    (∫ t : Angle, fourier (-a) t • (fourier b t • v) ∂angularMeasure) = if b = a then v else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_add
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_add {E : Type u_97} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f g : ℂ → E} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g 0) (k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun z => f z+g z) k = taylorCoeff f k+taylorCoeff g k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_congr
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_congr {E : Type u_96} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f g : ℂ → E} (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 0] g) (k : ℕ) : taylorCoeff f k = taylorCoeff g k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem taylorCoeff_const {E : Type u_101} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (v : E) (k : ℕ) : taylorCoeff (fun _ => v) k = if k = 0 then v else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_eq_series
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_eq_series {E : Type u_102} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : ℂ → E} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ E} {r : ℝ≥0∞}

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_pow_mul
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_pow_mul {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) (j k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun u => u^j*f u) k = if j ≤ k then taylorCoeff f (k-j) else 0

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_smul_const
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_smul_const {E : Type u_100} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0) (v : E) (k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun z => f z • v) k = taylorCoeff f k • v

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.taylorCoeff_sum
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_sum {E : Type u_98} {ι : Type u_99} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [CompleteSpace E]
    (I : Finset ι) {f : ι → ℂ → E} (hf : ∀ i ∈ I, AnalyticAt ℂ (f i) 0) (k : ℕ) :
    taylorCoeff (fun z => ∑ i ∈ I, f i z) k = ∑ i ∈ I, taylorCoeff (f i) k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.faberBasis_eval
statement:
theorem faberBasis_eval (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (faberBasis c g k).eval z = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
      taylorCoeff (fun u => localN c g u * localW c g u^j) k * z^j

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.faberBasis_exterior
statement:
theorem faberBasis_exterior {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ ball 0 R) (hv0 : v ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ ball 0 R, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (faberBasis c g k).eval (exterior c g v⁻¹) = v⁻¹^k +
      taylorCoeff (fun u => correction c g u v) k

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.markov_kernel_contraction
statement:
theorem markov_kernel_contraction {α : Type u_124} {β : Type u_125} {E : Type u_126}
    [MetricSpace α] [MeasurableSpace α] [BorelSpace α] [CompactSpace α]
    [SecondCountableTopology α]
    [MetricSpace β] [MeasurableSpace β] [BorelSpace β] [CompactSpace β]
    [SecondCountableTopology β]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (K : α → β → ℝ) (u : α → E)
    (hK : Continuous K.uncurry) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hpos : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y)
    (hcol : ∀ y, ∫ x, K x y ∂μ = 1)
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∫ y, K x y ∂ν = 1) :
    (∫ y, ‖∫ x, K x y • u x ∂μ‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) ≤ ∫ x, ‖u x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

    (hui : Integrable (fun x => k x • u x) μ)
    (hsqi : Integrable (fun x => k x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hmass : ∫ x, k x ∂μ = 1) :
    ‖∫ x, k x • u x ∂μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, k x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

statement:
theorem algebraGenerating_exterior (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (A : 𝔄) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) :
    algebraGenerating c g A ζ⁻¹ = (ζ*(c-ζ⁻¹^2*deriv g ζ⁻¹)) •

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Faber.algebraGenerating_fourier
statement:
theorem algebraGenerating_fourier {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (A : 𝔄)
    (hunit : ∀ u ∈ closedBall 0 1, IsUnit (algebraDenominator c g A u)) :
    (Continuous (fun t : Angle => algebraGenerating c g A (unitPoint t)⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => algebraGenerating c g A (unitPoint t)⁻¹)
      (-(k:ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (faberBasis c g k)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff (fun t : Angle => algebraGenerating c g A (unitPoint t)⁻¹) k = 0)

theorem ringInverse_geometric {𝔄 : Type u_129} [NormedRing 𝔄] [NormedAlgebra ℂ 𝔄]

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.exterior_collar_bound
statement:
theorem exterior_collar_bound {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hinj : InjOn (Faber.exterior c g) (Inv.inv ⁻¹' ball 0 R \ {0}))
    (hder : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ζ ≠ 0 → ζ⁻¹ ∈ ball 0 R → deriv (Faber.exterior c g) ζ ≠ 0)
    (hboundary : ∀ t s, 0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t) *
      (Faber.boundary c g t-Faber.boundary c g s)).re)
    (houtside : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖ζ‖ → Faber.exterior c g ζ ∉ numericalRange A)
    (hsupport : ∀ t, ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A,
      0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t) * (Faber.boundary c g t-w)).re)
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (Faber.boundary c g t) F‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖ ≤ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.faber_matrix_coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem faber_matrix_coefficient_bounds {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ ball 0 R, ∀ v ∈ ball 0 R, Faber.chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0)
    (hpositive : ∀ t s, 0 ≤ Faber.boundaryKernel c g t s)
    {m N : ℕ} (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    (∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy (Faber.boundary c g) (faberPolynomial (Faber.faberBasis c g) C))
    ∧
      (polynomialEnergy (Faber.boundary c g) (faberPolynomial (Faber.faberBasis c g) C) ≤
        ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.faber_resolvent_data
statement:
theorem faber_resolvent_data {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (houtside : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖ζ‖ → Faber.exterior c g ζ ∉ numericalRange A)
    (hsupport : ∀ t, ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A,
      0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t) * (Faber.boundary c g t-w)).re) :
    ∃ Q : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ,
      Continuous Q ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff Q (-(k:ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (Faber.faberBasis c g k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff Q k = 0) ∧
      (∀ t, (Q t+(Q t)ᴴ).PosSemidef)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.Conformal.compact_inverse_disk
statement:
theorem compact_inverse_disk {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {a : ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : NormalizedEmbedding U a f)

      (∀ z ∈ ball p (3*r), ‖E z‖ < 1 ↔ z ∈ U) ∧ deriv E p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ V : Set ℂ, ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, IsOpen V ∧ closure U ⊆ V ∧
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F V ∧ EqOn F f U ∧

theorem segment_cut (hF : ForestOrder V) {H : Set V} (hH : IsLowerSet H)
    {f k : V → ℝ} (hf : SupportedOn f H) (hk : SupportedOn k Hᶜ)
    {s τ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hτ : |τ| ≤ 1)
    {S : Finset V} (hS : IsSegment S) :
    ∃ L : Finset V, L ⊆ S.filter (· ∈ H) ∧ IsSegment L ∧
      IsSegment (S.filter (· ∈ H) \ L) ∧
      (segSum f S + s * segSum (correctedTail H f k s τ) S) ^ 2 ≤
        (segSum f S - segSum f L) ^ 2 + segSum f L ^ 2 +
        8 * s ^ 2 * (∑ v ∈ S, gateWeight H k v) +
        s ^ 2 * segSum (correctedTail H f k s τ) S ^ 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.conjugate_difference_sub_invariant
statement:
lemma conjugate_difference_sub_invariant (U : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ))
    (D Y : Matrix n n ℂ) (hY : conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U Y = Y) :
    2 • (D + Y) - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (D + Y) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) (D + Y) =
      2 • D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U D - conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star U) D

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.gaussian_phase_average
statement:
lemma gaussian_phase_average (z : n → ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : ℝ≥0) (i j : n) :
    (∫ t, conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) D ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v) i j =
      Complex.exp (-((v : ℝ) * (z i - z j) ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ)) * D i j

statement:
lemma gaussian_trace_comparison (z : n → ℝ) (M D : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hpoint : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (trace (M * (2 • D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) D -
      conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (star (phaseUnitary z t)) D))).re) :
    (trace (M * (∫ t, conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) (phaseUnitary z t) D
      ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v))).re ≤ (trace (M * D)).re

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.hsSquared_cfc_sub
statement:
lemma hsSquared_cfc_sub {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hf : ∀ i j, |f (hA.eigenvalues i) - f (hB.eigenvalues j)| ≤
      L * |hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j|) :
    hsSquared (hA.cfc f - hB.cfc f) ≤ L ^ 2 * hsSquared (A - B)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.mixed_diagonal_sub
statement:
lemma mixed_diagonal_sub (U V : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (a b : n → ℝ) :
    star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (diagonal (fun i ↦ (a i : ℂ))) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) V (diagonal (fun i ↦ (b i : ℂ)))) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ) =
      diagonal (fun i ↦ (a i : ℂ)) * (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) -
        (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) * diagonal (fun i ↦ (b i : ℂ))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixProof.mixed_diagonal_sub_apply
statement:
lemma mixed_diagonal_sub_apply (U V : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ)) (a b : n → ℝ)
    (i j : n) :
    (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      (conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) U (diagonal (fun i ↦ (a i : ℂ))) -
        conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Matrix n n ℂ) V (diagonal (fun i ↦ (b i : ℂ)))) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j =
      ((a i - b j : ℝ) : ℂ) * (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (V : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j

    -A⁻¹ + A⁻¹ * (B - A) * A⁻¹ - (-B⁻¹) =
      (A⁻¹ * (B - A)) * B⁻¹ * ((B - A) * A⁻¹)
