statement: lemma normSum_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : normSum T e (-v) = normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_nonneg
statement: lemma normSum_nonneg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : 0 ≤ normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_on_head
statement:
lemma normSum_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_smul
statement: lemma normSum_smul (a : ℝ) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : normSum T e (a • v) = |a| * normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma normSum_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normSum_zero : normSum T e 0 = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_add_le
statement:
lemma potentials_add_le (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (v + w) s ≤ P T e v s + P T e w s ∧ Q T e (v + w) s ≤ Q T e v s + Q T e w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_minimal
statement:
lemma potentials_minimal (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s)
    (hpU : GlobalUpper T e p) (hqU : GlobalUpper T e q) (s : ι) :
    P T e v s ≤ p s ∧ Q T e v s ≤ q s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_neg
statement:
lemma potentials_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (-v) s = Q T e v s ∧ Q T e (-v) s = P T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_on_head
statement:
theorem potentials_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) (s : H) :
    P T e v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).pfields e (fun c => v c.1) s).1 ∧
    Q T e v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).pfields e (fun c => v c.1) s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_smul_le
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (a • v) s ≤ a * P T e v s ∧ Q T e (a • v) s ≤ a * Q T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (a • v) s = a * P T e v s ∧ Q T e (a • v) s = a * Q T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_zero
statement: lemma potentials_zero (s : ι) : P T e 0 s = 0 ∧ Q T e 0 s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_difference
statement:
lemma leastPair_difference (x a b : ℝ) :
    (leastPair x a b).1 - (leastPair x a b).2 = x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_minimal
statement:
lemma leastPair_minimal {x a b p q : ℝ} (hdiff : p - q = x)
    (hp : a ≤ p) (hq : b ≤ q) :
    (leastPair x a b).1 ≤ p ∧ (leastPair x a b).2 ≤ q

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_nonneg
statement:
lemma leastPair_nonneg {x a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    0 ≤ (leastPair x a b).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (leastPair x a b).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.sum_add_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_add_sq_le {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hf : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hg : ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (f i + g i) ^ 2 ≤ (a + b) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.CofiniteSubspace.exists_unit
statement:
lemma exists_unit (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.CofiniteSubspace.nontrivial_space
statement:
lemma nontrivial_space (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :

lemma Initial.child_not_mem {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) {s c : ι}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Q_eq_zero_off_head

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper.add

lemma Upper.add {p q : ι → ℝ} (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper.le_root
statement:
lemma Upper.le_root {p : ι → ℝ} (hpU : T.Upper p) (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (s : ι) :
    p s ≤ p T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper.smul
statement:
lemma Upper.smul {p : ι → ℝ} (hpU : T.Upper p) (a : ℝ) :
    T.Upper (fun s => a * p s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.abs_coordinate_le_rootSum
statement: lemma abs_coordinate_le_rootSum (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : |v s| ≤ T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.ancestorClosure_subset_of_initial
statement:
lemma ancestorClosure_subset_of_initial {S H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (hS : S ⊆ H) :
    T.ancestorClosure S ⊆ H

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.ancestors_subset_of_initial
statement:
lemma ancestors_subset_of_initial {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    T.ancestors s ⊆ H

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.averaged_feasible
statement:
lemma averaged_feasible (x z : ι → ℝ) :
    T.Upper (fun s => ((T.fields (x + z) s).1 + (T.fields (x - z) s).1) / 2) ∧
    T.Upper (fun s => ((T.fields (x + z) s).2 + (T.fields (x - z) s).2) / 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.commonRoot_finite_cubic
statement:
theorem commonRoot_finite_cubic {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0)
    (hxroot : x T.root = 0) (hz0 : z ≠ 0) :
    T.rootCommon x + (T.rootCommon z) ^ 3 /
        (8 * (2 * T.rootCommon x + T.rootCommon z) ^ 2) ≤
      (T.rootCommon (x + z) + T.rootCommon (x - z)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_energy_step
statement:
lemma defect_energy_step (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, energy (T.fields x c).1 (T.fields x c).2 (T.defect x z c) ≤
      energy (T.fields x s).1 (T.fields x s).2 (T.defect x z s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_nonneg
statement: lemma defect_nonneg (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.defect x z s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_off_head
statement:
lemma defect_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.defect x z s = ((T.fields z s).1 + (T.fields z s).2) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_representation
statement:
lemma defect_representation (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ((T.fields (x + z) s).1 + (T.fields (x - z) s).1) / 2 =
      (T.fields x s).1 + T.defect x z s ∧
    ((T.fields (x + z) s).2 + (T.fields (x - z) s).2) / 2 =
      (T.fields x s).2 + T.defect x z s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_add_le
statement:
lemma fields_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields (v + w) s).1 ≤ (T.fields v s).1 + (T.fields w s).1 ∧
    (T.fields (v + w) s).2 ≤ (T.fields v s).2 + (T.fields w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_eq_off_head
statement:
theorem fields_eq_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hvw : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.fields v s = T.fields w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_head_zero
statement:
lemma fields_head_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.fields v s = (0, 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_neg
statement:
lemma fields_neg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields (-v) s = ((T.fields v s).2, (T.fields v s).1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_smul
statement:
lemma fields_smul (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields (a • v) s = (a * (T.fields v s).1, a * (T.fields v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_smul_le
statement:
lemma fields_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields (a • v) s).1 ≤ a * (T.fields v s).1 ∧
    (T.fields (a • v) s).2 ≤ a * (T.fields v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_tight
statement:
lemma fields_tight (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).1 ^ 2 = (T.fields v s).1 ^ 2) ∨
    (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).2 ^ 2 = (T.fields v s).2 ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_zero
statement: lemma fields_zero (s : ι) : T.fields (fun _ => 0) s = (0, 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_sq_le_children
statement:
lemma max_fields_sq_le_children (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) (hv : v s = 0) :
    (max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ c ∈ T.children s, (max (T.fields v c).1 (T.fields v c).2) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_cubic
statement:
theorem normSum_cubic (x z : ι →₀ ℝ) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hx : x.support ⊆ H) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) :
    (T.normSum z) ^ 3 ≤ 8 * T.meanExcess x z *
      (2 * T.normSum x + T.meanExcess x z) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_on_head
statement:
lemma normSum_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) : T.normSum v = (T.restrict H hH).rootSum (fun s => v s.1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_le_normSum
statement:
lemma potentials_le_normSum (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P v s ≤ T.normSum v ∧ T.Q v s ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_lipschitz
statement:
lemma potentials_lipschitz (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    |T.P v s - T.P w s| ≤ T.normSum (v - w) ∧
    |T.Q v s - T.Q w s| ≤ T.normSum (v - w)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_on_head
statement:
theorem potentials_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) (s : H) :
    T.P v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).fields (fun c => v c.1) s).1 ∧
    T.Q v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).fields (fun c => v c.1) s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.restrict_initial
statement:
lemma restrict_initial (K : Finset ι) (hK : T.Initial K) (H : Finset ι)
    (hH : T.Initial H) :
    (T.restrict K hK).Initial (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : K => s.1 ∈ H))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootCommon_eq_half_sum
statement:
lemma rootCommon_eq_half_sum (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) :
    T.rootCommon v = T.rootSum v / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_add_le
statement: lemma rootSum_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) : T.rootSum (v + w) ≤ T.rootSum v + T.rootSum w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_cubic
statement:
theorem rootSum_cubic {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) :
    (T.rootSum z) ^ 3 ≤ 64 * T.defect x z T.root *
      (T.rootSum x + T.defect x z T.root) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_defect
statement:
lemma rootSum_defect (x z : ι → ℝ) :
    (T.rootSum (x + z) + T.rootSum (x - z)) / 2 =
      T.rootSum x + 2 * T.defect x z T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_eq_twice_max_of_root_zero
statement:
lemma rootSum_eq_twice_max_of_root_zero (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) :
    T.rootSum v = 2 * max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_finite_midpoint_gap
statement:
theorem rootSum_finite_midpoint_gap {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0)
    (hunit : T.rootSum x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hzt : t ≤ T.rootSum z) :
    1 + t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ (T.rootSum (x + z) + T.rootSum (x - z)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_neg (v : ι → ℝ) : T.rootSum (-v) = T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_nonneg
statement: lemma rootSum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_pos
statement: lemma rootSum_pos {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma rootSum_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.rootSum (a • v) = a * T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_zero : T.rootSum (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.root_mem_ancestors
statement: lemma root_mem_ancestors (s : ι) : T.root ∈ T.ancestors s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_children
statement:
lemma sum_children (e : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c = ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ.erase T.root, e c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_leaves_le_root
statement:
lemma sum_leaves_le_root (e : ι → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c ≤ e s) :
    ∑ b ∈ T.leaves, e b ≤ e T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.tail_energy
statement:
theorem tail_energy {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) (s : ι) :
    (max (T.fields z s).1 (T.fields z s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * energy (T.fields x s).1 (T.fields x s).2 (T.defect x z s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.two_field_energy
statement:
theorem two_field_energy (p q d : ι → ℝ) (J : Finset ι) (hJ : J ⊆ T.leaves)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hd : ∀ s, 0 ≤ d s)
    (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp'U : T.Upper (fun s => p s + d s))
    (hq'U : T.Upper (fun s => q s + d s))
    (htight : ∀ s, (T.children s).Nonempty →
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 = p s ^ 2) ∨
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, q c ^ 2 = q s ^ 2))
    (_hzero : ∀ b ∈ J, p b = 0 ∧ q b = 0) :
    ∑ b ∈ J, d b ^ 2 ≤ energy (p T.root) (q T.root) (d T.root)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.two_field_energy_all_leaves
statement:
theorem two_field_energy_all_leaves (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hd : ∀ s, 0 ≤ d s)
    (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp'U : T.Upper (fun s => p s + d s))
    (hq'U : T.Upper (fun s => q s + d s))
    (htight : ∀ s, (T.children s).Nonempty →
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 = p s ^ 2) ∨
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, q c ^ 2 = q s ^ 2)) :
    ∑ b ∈ T.leaves, d b ^ 2 ≤ energy (p T.root) (q T.root) (d T.root)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.P_coe

    (energy p q d) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = d * (2 * p + d) * (2 * q + d)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_step
statement:
lemma energy_step {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    {P Q D : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hPupper : ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 ≤ P ^ 2)
    (hQupper : ∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hPupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (P + D) ^ 2)
    (hQupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (q i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (Q + D) ^ 2)
    (htight : (∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 = P ^ 2) ∨ (∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 = Q ^ 2)) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, energy (p i) (q i) (d i) ≤ energy P Q D

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_step_first
statement:
lemma energy_step_first {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    {P Q D : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hPtight : ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 = P ^ 2)
    (hQupper : ∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hPupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (P + D) ^ 2)
    (hQupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (q i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (Q + D) ^ 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, energy (p i) (q i) (d i) ≤ energy P Q D

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.joinedNode_parent

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.sequenceChildren_spec

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weaklyNull_of_finsupp_bound

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weaklyNull_of_square_sum_bound

lemma weaklyNull_of_square_sum_bound {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weighted_square_bound

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.block_square_comparison
statement:
lemma block_square_comparison (v : ι → ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) :
    ((max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ((h : ℝ) + 1) * ∑ s, v s ^ 2) ∧
    ((∑ s, v s ^ 2) ≤ 4 * ((h : ℝ) + 1) *
      (max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2) ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_eq
statement:
lemma descEnergy_eq (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.descEnergy v s = v s ^ 2 + ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.descEnergy v c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_nonneg
statement: lemma descEnergy_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.descEnergy v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_root
statement: lemma descEnergy_root (v : ι → ℝ) : T.descEnergy v T.root = ∑ s, v s ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_le
statement:
lemma max_fields_le (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2 ≤
      |v s| + Real.sqrt (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (max (T.fields v c).1 (T.fields v c).2) ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_square_le
statement:
lemma max_fields_square_le (v : ι → ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (s : ι) :
    (max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ((h : ℝ) + 1 - T.depth s) * T.descEnergy v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.upper_sum_square_le
statement:
lemma upper_sum_square_le {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : T.Upper p) (h : ℕ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.weighted_sum_children
statement:
lemma weighted_sum_children (w e : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, w s * ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c =

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.IsReflexive.of_equiv

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Joined.field_root

statement:
lemma isReflexive_iff {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.lens_half_difference

lemma lens_half_difference {x z w : E} {R : ℝ}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.norm_center_le

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.norm_perturbation_le

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.ChildExponent.agg_le_iff
statement:
lemma agg_le_iff {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    p.agg s f ≤ a ↔ (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p.val) ≤ a ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.ChildExponent.agg_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma agg_neg {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) : p.agg s (-f) = p.agg s f

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.add
statement:
lemma PUpper.add {a b : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) (hb : T.PUpper p b) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.le_root
statement: lemma PUpper.le_root {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) (s : ι) : a s ≤ a T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.smul
statement:
lemma PUpper.smul {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.zero
statement: lemma PUpper.zero : T.PUpper p (fun _ => 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exists_tight_label
statement:
lemma exists_tight_label (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ∃ b : Bool, T.pField p v b s ^ p.val = ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v b c ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_succ
statement:
lemma exitCut_succ {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    T.exitCut H (j+1) = T.childrenOf (T.headLevel H j) ∪ T.stoppedExit H j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_succ_disjoint
OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_zero
statement: lemma exitCut_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) : T.exitCut H 0 = {T.root}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_cut_mass
statement:
lemma fields_cut_mass {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, (T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val) ≤
      T.pRootSum p v ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_subcut_mass
statement:
lemma fields_subcut_mass {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) (hS : S ⊆ T.exitCut H j) :
    ∑ s ∈ S, (T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val) ≤
      T.pRootSum p v ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.headLevel_stopped_disjoint
statement:
lemma headLevel_stopped_disjoint (H : Finset ι) (j : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (T.headLevel H j) (T.stoppedExit H j)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_nonneg
statement: lemma pField_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (b : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.pField p v b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_power_sum_le_norm
statement:
lemma pField_power_sum_le_norm (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val ≤
      ((T.pfields p v s).1 + (T.pfields p v s).2) ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_power_upper
statement:
lemma pField_power_upper (v : ι → ℝ) (b : Bool) (s : ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v b c ^ p.val ≤ T.pField p v b s ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_add_le
statement: lemma pRootSum_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) : T.pRootSum p (v+w) ≤ T.pRootSum p v + T.pRootSum p w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_coordinate
statement: lemma pRootSum_coordinate (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : |v s| ≤ T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma pRootSum_neg (v : ι → ℝ) : T.pRootSum p (-v) = T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma pRootSum_smul_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    T.pRootSum p (a • v) = a * T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_tail_midpoint
statement:
lemma pRootSum_tail_midpoint (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    T.pRootSum p y ≤ (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma pRootSum_zero : T.pRootSum p (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_add_le
statement:
lemma pfields_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p (v+w) s).1 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).1 + (T.pfields p w s).1 ∧
    (T.pfields p (v+w) s).2 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).2 + (T.pfields p w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_eq_off_head
statement:
lemma pfields_eq_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hvw : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.pfields p v s = T.pfields p w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_head_le
statement:
lemma pfields_head_le {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (hvw : ∀ s ∈ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 ≤ (T.pfields p w s).1 ∧ (T.pfields p v s).2 ≤ (T.pfields p w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_head_zero
statement:
lemma pfields_head_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.pfields p v s = (0,0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_neg
statement:
lemma pfields_neg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p (-v) s = ((T.pfields p v s).2, (T.pfields p v s).1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_smul
statement:
lemma pfields_smul (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p (a • v) s = (a * (T.pfields p v s).1, a * (T.pfields p v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_smul_le
statement:
lemma pfields_smul_le (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p (a • v) s).1 ≤ a * (T.pfields p v s).1 ∧
    (T.pfields p (a • v) s).2 ≤ a * (T.pfields p v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_tight
statement:
lemma pfields_tight (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 = p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).1) ∨
    (T.pfields p v s).2 = p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_zero
statement: lemma pfields_zero (s : ι) : T.pfields p (fun _ => 0) s = (0,0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.root_le_sum_exitCut
statement:
lemma root_le_sum_exitCut {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s ∈ H, f s ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c) (j : ℕ) :
    f T.root ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H j, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_exitCut_le_root
statement:
lemma sum_exitCut_le_root {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s ∈ H, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c ≤ f s) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H j, f c ≤ f T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_exitCut_succ
statement:
lemma sum_exitCut_succ {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1) (j : ℕ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H (j+1), f c =
      (∑ s ∈ T.headLevel H j, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c) + ∑ c ∈ T.stoppedExit H j, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.tightLabel_spec
statement:
lemma tightLabel_spec (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p v (T.tightLabel p v s) s ^ p.val =
      ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v (T.tightLabel p v s) c ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.uniform_sequential_separation
statement:
theorem uniform_sequential_separation {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) (x z : ℕ → ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ n, T.normSum (x n) = 1)
    (hz : ∀ n s, s ∈ T.head (x n) → z n s = 0)
    (hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (T.normSum (x n + z n) + T.normSum (x n - z n))/2)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T.normSum (z n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.accumulated_bound
statement:
lemma accumulated_bound {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (K : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 0 ≤ K j)
    {h : ℕ} (hrec : ∀ j < h, K (j+1) ^ p ≤ p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) * K j) :
    ∀ j ≤ h, K j ≤ recurrenceCeiling * K 0 ^ ((1/p)^j)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.accumulated_cut_recursion
statement:
lemma accumulated_cut_recursion {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (a d : Bool → ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ a σ s) (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s)
    (hloc : ∀ σ s, s ∈ H → ∑ c ∈ T.children s, d σ c ^ p ≤
      p * a σ s ^ (p-1) * d σ s)
    (hext : ∀ σ s, s ∉ H → a σ s = d σ s)
    (j : ℕ) (hA : ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, a σ s ^ p ≤ 3) :
    cutEnergy T p H d (j+1) ^ p ≤
      p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) * cutEnergy T p H d j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.coefficient_nonneg
statement: lemma coefficient_nonneg (σ : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ coefficient T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.common_increment
statement:
lemma common_increment (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s = T.pField p x b s + increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cubic_of_accumulated
statement:
lemma cubic_of_accumulated (h : ℕ+) (K : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 0 ≤ K j)
    (hrec : ∀ j < h.val, K (j+1) ^ heightExponent h ≤
      heightExponent h * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((heightExponent h - 1) / heightExponent h) * K j)
    {Y : ℝ} (hY0 : 0 ≤ Y) (hY1 : Y ≤ 1) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * K h.val) :
    cubicConstant * Y ^ 3 ≤ K 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_nonneg (p : ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (d : Bool → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cutEnergy T p H d j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_pow
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_pow {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (H : Finset ι) (d : Bool → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s) (j : ℕ) :
    cutEnergy T p H d j ^ p = ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, d σ s ^ p

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_zero_le_gap
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_zero_le_gap (hp : 1 < p.val) :
    cutEnergy T p.val H (increment T p H x y) 0 ≤
      (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.endpoint_on_head
statement:
lemma endpoint_on_head {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {H : Finset ι} {x y : ι → ℝ}
    (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0) (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) : (x + signed y σ) s = x s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.exit_sign_mass
statement:
lemma exit_sign_mass (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    (∑ σ, increment T p H x y σ s ^ p.val) =
      T.pField p y true s ^ p.val + T.pField p y false s ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.finite_cubic
statement:
theorem finite_cubic (h : ℕ+) (hp : p.val = heightExponent h)
    (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h.val) :
    cubicConstant * T.pRootSum p y ^ 3 ≤
      ((T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x) *
        max (T.pRootSum p (x+y)) (T.pRootSum p (x-y)) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.finite_cubic_normalized
statement:
theorem finite_cubic_normalized (h : ℕ+) (hp : p.val = heightExponent h)
    (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h.val)
    (hM : ∀ σ, T.pRootSum p (x + signed y σ) ≤ 1) :
    cubicConstant * T.pRootSum p y ^ 3 ≤
      (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.head_field_le
statement:
lemma head_field_le (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p x b s ≤ T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_le_two
statement: lemma heightExponent_le_two (h : ℕ+) : heightExponent h ≤ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_pow_le_exp
statement: lemma heightExponent_pow_le_exp (h : ℕ+) : heightExponent h ^ h.val ≤ Real.exp 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.holder_powers
statement:
lemma holder_powers {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (a d : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ (p-1) * d i ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ p) ^ ((p-1)/p) * (∑ i ∈ s, d i ^ p) ^ (1/p)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.holder_powers_two
statement:
lemma holder_powers_two {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (a d : Bool → ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ σ i, 0 ≤ a σ i) (hd : ∀ σ i, 0 ≤ d σ i) :
    ∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, a σ i ^ (p-1) * d σ i ≤
      (∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, a σ i ^ p) ^ ((p-1)/p) *
      (∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, d σ i ^ p) ^ (1/p)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.increment_nonneg
statement: lemma increment_nonneg (σ : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.layer_increment
statement:
lemma layer_increment (_hp : 1 < p.val) (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, increment T p H x y σ c ^ p.val ≤
      p.val * coefficient T p H x y σ s ^ (p.val-1) * increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.outside_field_eq
statement:
lemma outside_field_eq (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s = T.pField p (signed y σ) b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.prefix_child_increment
statement:
lemma prefix_child_increment (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (_hs : s ∈ H) (c : ι) (hc : c ∈ T.children s) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) (T.tightLabel p x s) c =
      T.pField p x (T.tightLabel p x s) c + increment T p H x y σ c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrenceCeiling_one_le
statement: lemma recurrenceCeiling_one_le : 1 ≤ recurrenceCeiling

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrenceCeiling_pos

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.rpow_increment_le

statement:

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_false
statement: @[simp] lemma signed_false (y : ι → ℝ) : signed y false = -y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_smul

statement:
lemma tailFlux_local (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tail_le_cutEnergy
statement:
lemma tail_le_cutEnergy (hp : 1 < p.val) {h : ℕ} (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.total_coefficient_mass
statement:
lemma total_coefficient_mass {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (p : ChildExponent) {H : Finset ι} {x y : ι → ℝ} (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0)
    (_hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0) (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hM : ∀ σ, T.pRootSum p (x + signed y σ) ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, coefficient T p H x y σ s ^ p.val ≤ 3

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.matched_opposite_crossing
statement:
theorem matched_opposite_crossing {ι κ Γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype Γ]
    {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    (p : V →₀ ℝ) (hp : p.support ⊆ H)
    (a b : ι → V) (a' b' : κ → V)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i) (hab' : ∀ j, a' j ≤ b' j)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)) (Finset.Icc (a j) (b j)))
    (hd' : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a' i) (b' i)) (Finset.Icc (a' j) (b' j)))
    (gate : Γ → V) (left : Γ → ι) (right : Γ → κ)
    (hl : Function.Injective left) (hr : Function.Injective right)
    (hgate : ∀ g, gate g ∉ H)
    (hmem : ∀ g, a (left g) ≤ gate g ∧ gate g ≤ b (left g))
    (hmem' : ∀ g, a' (right g) ≤ gate g ∧ gate g ≤ b' (right g))
    (hop : ∀ g, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (left g)) (b (left g)), p v) *
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' (right g)) (b' (right g)), p v) < 0) :
    2 * ∑ g, |(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (left g)) (b (left g)), p v) *
        (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' (right g)) (b' (right g)), p v)| ≤
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a i) (b i), p v) ^ 2) +
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' j) (b' j), p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.opposite_crossing
statement:
theorem opposite_crossing (F F' : SegmentFamily V) {H : Finset V}
    (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H) (p : V →₀ ℝ) (hp : p.support ⊆ H)
    (G : Finset V) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, Gate H g) :
    (∑ g : G, (|F.boundary p g.val * F'.boundary p g.val| -
      F.boundary p g.val * F'.boundary p g.val)) ≤
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - F.seminorm p ^ 2) +
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - F'.seminorm p ^ 2)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.opposite_split_gain
statement:
theorem opposite_split_gain {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    {p : V →₀ ℝ} (hp : p.support ⊆ H) {a c g b b' : V}
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcg : c ≤ g) (hgb : g ≤ b) (hgb' : g ≤ b')
    (hg : g ∉ H)
    (hop : (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) * (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b', p v) < 0) :
    2 * |(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) * (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b', p v)| ≤
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico a c, p v) ^ 2 + (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b, p v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.segment_sum_eq_head
statement:
theorem segment_sum_eq_head {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    {p : V →₀ ℝ} (hp : p.support ⊆ H) {a g b : V}
    (hag : a ≤ g) (hgb : g ≤ b) (hg : g ∉ H) :
    (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) = ∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico a g, p v

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.selected_split_budget
statement:
theorem selected_split_budget {ι Γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Γ]
    (p : V →₀ ℝ) (a b : ι → V) (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)) (Finset.Icc (a j) (b j)))
    (select : Γ → ι) (hinj : Function.Injective select) (cut : Γ → V)
    (hcut : ∀ g, a (select g) ≤ cut g ∧ cut g ≤ b (select g))
    (cost : Γ → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g)
    (hgain : ∀ g, cost g ≤
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico (a (select g)) (cut g), p v) ^ 2 +
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (cut g) (b (select g)), p v) ^ 2 -
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (select g)) (b (select g)), p v) ^ 2) :
    ∑ g, cost g ≤ segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 -
      ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a i) (b i), p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.split_disjoint
statement: theorem split_disjoint (a c b : V) : Disjoint (Finset.Ico a c) (Finset.Icc c b)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.split_interval
statement:
theorem split_interval {a c b : V} (hac : a ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.split_suffix_sum
statement:
theorem split_suffix_sum {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    {p : V →₀ ℝ} (hp : p.support ⊆ H) {c g b b' : V}
    (hcg : c ≤ g) (hgb : g ≤ b) (hgb' : g ≤ b') (hg : g ∉ H) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.joint_identity
statement:
theorem joint_identity (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {ι : Ω → Type*}
    [∀ ω, Fintype (ι ω)] (a b : (ω : Ω) → ι ω → ℝ) (r : ℝ)
    (hpair : μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, a ω i * b ω i) = r ^ 2) :
    μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, (a ω i - b ω i) ^ 2) +
      μ.mean (fun ω => r ^ 2 - ∑ i, b ω i ^ 2) =
      μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, a ω i ^ 2) - r ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem mean_add (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.mean (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = μ.mean f + μ.mean g

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_const
statement: @[simp] theorem mean_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) : μ.mean (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_mono
statement:
theorem mean_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mean_mul (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_nonneg
statement:
theorem mean_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem mean_sub (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.sq_mean_le
statement:
theorem sq_mean_le (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.joint_budget_tail
statement:
theorem joint_budget_tail {η θ R r t : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hbudget : η + θ ≤ R ^ 2 - r ^ 2)
    (htail : t ≤ Real.sqrt η + Real.sqrt (η + 2 * θ)) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.joint_sqrt_bound
statement:
theorem joint_sqrt_bound {η θ : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.clip_seminorm

theorem SegmentFamily.clip_seminorm {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.clip_subset

theorem SegmentFamily.clip_subset {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.ofPieces_sq

theorem SegmentFamily.ofPieces_sq (S : ι → Finset V)

    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) ≤
      (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g) ^ 2) + 2 * μ.mean L

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.absolute_mass_identity

theorem absolute_mass_identity (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b : Ω → Γ → ℝ) :

      (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g) ^ 2) =
    (μ.product μ).mean (fun ω => ∑ g, (|b ω.1 g * b ω.2 g| - b ω.1 g * b ω.2 g))

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.expect_map

    μ.expect (fun ω => T (f ω)) = T (μ.expect f)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.joint_mass_bound

theorem joint_mass_bound (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b W : Ω → Γ → ℝ) (V L : Ω → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g + W ω g) = 0)
    (hW : ∀ ω, (∑ g, W ω g ^ 2) ≤ V ω)
    (hc : ∀ ω ω', (∑ g, (|b ω g * b ω' g| - b ω g * b ω' g)) ≤ L ω + L ω') :
    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) ≤ μ.mean V + 2 * μ.mean L

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.mean_sum

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.norm_expect_le

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.pooled_expect

theorem pooled_expect {Ω' E : Type*} [Fintype Ω'] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module ℝ E]
    (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Ω') (f : Ω → E) (g : Ω' → E) :
    (μ.pooled ν).expect (Sum.elim f g) = (1/2 : ℝ) • μ.expect f + (1/2 : ℝ) • ν.expect g

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.product_mean

    (f : Ω × Ω' → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.product_mul

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_center_bounds
statement:
theorem shell_center_bounds {x z : ℂ} {r δ : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hz : z ∈ thinShell x r δ) :
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖x - z‖ ∧ ‖x - z‖ ≤ 3

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_mass_le_jump
statement:
theorem shell_mass_le_jump (S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {x z : ℂ} {r ρ δ : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) (hz : z ∈ thinShell x r δ) :
    (S (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ)).toReal ≤
      tangentMass S ρ z (‖x - z‖⁻¹ • (x - z)) (‖x - z‖ + 200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) -
      tangentMass S ρ z (‖x - z‖⁻¹ • (x - z)) (‖x - z‖ - 200 * δ / ρ ^ 2)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_pair_close
OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_subset_tangent_difference
statement:
theorem shell_subset_tangent_difference {z θ : ℂ} (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) {l ρ δ : ℝ}
    (hl : 1 / 2 ≤ l) (hl3 : l ≤ 3) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) :
    {y : ℂ | ρ ≤ ‖y - z‖ ∧ |‖y - (z + l • θ)‖ - l| ≤ 2 * δ} ⊆
      ({y : ℂ | ρ ≤ ‖y - z‖} ∩
        Metric.ball (z + (l + 200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) • θ) (l + 200 * δ / ρ ^ 2)) \
      ({y : ℂ | ρ ≤ ‖y - z‖} ∩
        Metric.ball (z + (l - 200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) • θ) (l - 200 * δ / ρ ^ 2))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.tangentMass_mono
statement:
theorem tangentMass_mono (S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure S] (ρ : ℝ)
    (z θ : ℂ) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) : Monotone (tangentMass S ρ z θ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.tangentMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem tangentMass_nonneg (S : Measure ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (z θ : ℂ) (L : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ tangentMass S ρ z θ L

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_affine_strip
statement:
theorem volume_affine_strip {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b c d R w : ℝ) :
    volume {p : ℝ × ℝ | |p.2 - d| ≤ R ∧ |a * p.1 + b * p.2 + c| ≤ w} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * R) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (w / |a|))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_interval_fibers
statement:
theorem volume_interval_fibers (c : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : Continuous c)
    (lo hi w : ℝ) :
    volume {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.2 ∈ Icc lo hi ∧
      p.1 ∈ Icc (c p.2 - w) (c p.2 + w)} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (hi - lo) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * w)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_le_radial_sections
statement:
theorem volume_le_radial_sections {s : Set ℂ} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (z : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {B : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x - z‖ ≤ R)
    (hsections : ∀ θ : ℝ, volume {r : ℝ | 0 < r ∧
      z + (r : ℂ) * ((Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ s} ≤ B) :
    volume s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi * R) * B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_rayCondition
statement:
theorem volume_rayCondition (S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure S] (ρ : ℝ)
    {T U v : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (z : ℂ) :
    volume {x : ℂ | rayCondition S ρ T U v x z} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Real.pi) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * v * (1 + T / U))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_two_point_strip
statement:
theorem volume_two_point_strip {y z : ℂ} {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hyz : ρ ≤ ‖y - z‖) :
    volume {x : ℂ | ‖x - z‖ ≤ 3 ∧ |‖x - y‖ ^ 2 - ‖x - z‖ ^ 2| ≤ 13 * δ} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.bad_cap_bracket
statement:
theorem bad_cap_bracket (S ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure S] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {x z : ℂ} {r ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) (hz : z ∈ thinShell x r δ)
    (hi : S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T)
    (hb : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U) < (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ)) :
    1 ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * pairMass ν ρ δ x z +
      rayIndicator S ρ T U (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) x z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.lintegral_pairMass
statement:
theorem lintegral_pairMass (ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {ρ δ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (∫⁻ x : ℂ, ∫⁻ z : ℂ, pairMass ν ρ δ x z ∂ν) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ) * ν univ * ν univ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.lintegral_rayIndicator
statement:
theorem lintegral_rayIndicator (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    (ρ : ℝ) {T U v : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (∫⁻ x : ℂ, ∫⁻ z : ℂ, rayIndicator S ρ T U v x z ∂ν) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Real.pi) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * v * (1 + T / U))) * ν univ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.lintegral_shellMajorant
statement:
theorem lintegral_shellMajorant (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) :
    (∫⁻ x, shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ) * ν univ * ν univ) +
      (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ((ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Real.pi) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) * (1 + T / U))) * ν univ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurableSet_pairCondition
statement:
theorem measurableSet_pairCondition (ρ δ : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ | pairCondition ρ δ p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2}

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurable_pairMass
statement:
theorem measurable_pairMass (ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (ρ δ : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => pairMass ν ρ δ p.1 p.2)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurable_rayIndicator
statement:
theorem measurable_rayIndicator (S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure S] (ρ T U v : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurable_shellMajorant
statement:
theorem measurable_shellMajorant (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    (ρ δ T U : ℝ) : Measurable (shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.one_le_majorant_of_no_cap
statement:
theorem one_le_majorant_of_no_cap (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U)
    {x : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hν : ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ ν (thinShell x r δ))
    (hS : S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T)
    (hbad : ∀ z ∈ thinShell x r δ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U) < (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ)) :
    1 ≤ shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shellMajorant_eq_bracket
statement:
theorem shellMajorant_eq_bracket (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    (ρ δ T U : ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x = (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ z,
      ((ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * pairMass ν ρ δ x z +
        rayIndicator S ρ T U (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) x z) ∂ν

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_concentration
statement:
theorem shell_concentration (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ) * ν univ * ν univ) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ((ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Real.pi) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) * (1 + T / U))) * ν univ) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ ν (thinShell x r δ) →
        S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T →
        ∃ z ∈ thinShell x r δ,
          (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_pairCondition
statement:
theorem volume_pairCondition {ρ δ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (z y : ℂ) :
    volume {x : ℂ | pairCondition ρ δ x z y} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.imaginary_moment_integrand
statement:
lemma imaginary_moment_integrand (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x z : ℂ) :
    (star z * gradient g x).im = (fderiv ℝ g x) (Complex.I * z)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.imaginary_moment_zero
statement:
theorem imaginary_moment_zero {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g)
    (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, star (y - x) * gradient g y).im = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_fderiv_moment_real
statement:
lemma integral_fderiv_moment_real {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ y in Metric.ball x t, (fderiv ℝ g y) (y-x)) =
      (∫ y in Metric.ball x t, star (y-x) * gradient g y).re

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_fderiv_scale
statement:
lemma integral_fderiv_scale (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, (fderiv ℝ g (x+t•z)) z) =
      (t^3)⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x t, (fderiv ℝ g y) (y-x)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_rotation
statement:
lemma integral_rotation (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) (r t : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball 0 r, g (x + rotation t z)) =
      ∫ z in Metric.ball 0 r, g (x + z)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_scale_ball
statement:
lemma integral_scale_ball {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : ℂ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f (t • z)) =
      (t^2)⁻¹ • ∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) t, f z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.integral_translate_ball
statement:
lemma integral_translate_ball {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : ℂ → E) (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.rotation_zero

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.rotational_moment_zero

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.signedAverage_fixedDomain
statement:
lemma signedAverage_fixedDomain (g : ℂ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.cubeDensity_bound

lemma kernel_eq_integral {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x y : ℂ) :

lemma kernel_lipschitz {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_pairing
statement:
theorem kernel_pairing {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.balanced_kernel
statement:
theorem balanced_kernel {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {r δ : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ' : δ ≤ 1/4)
    (hm : signedAverage g x (r-δ) ≤ signedAverage g x r)
    (hp : signedAverage g x (r+δ) ≤ signedAverage g x r) :
    ∃ k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) ⟨216/δ, by positivity⟩,
      (∫ y, kernel k x y • (star (y-x) * gradient g y)) = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.cubeDensity_moment_integral

lemma cubeDensity_moment_integral {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (x : ℂ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ t, cubeDensity a b t • moment g x t) =

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.bounded_pairing
statement:
lemma bounded_pairing {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {M : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) : ‖∫ y, F y * b y‖ ≤ M * ∫ y, ‖b y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMass_bound
statement:
lemma coarseMass_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) : coarseMass b δ univ ≤ errorPrice b α / δ^(2*α)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma coarseMass_nonneg {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (δ : ℝ) (D : Set ℂ) :
    0 ≤ coarseMass b δ D

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMass_univ
statement:
lemma coarseMass_univ {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (δ : ℝ) :
    coarseMass b δ univ = ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => δ^2 ≤ (b d).size), (b d).mass

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarseMeasure_apply
statement:
lemma coarseMeasure_apply {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (δ : ℝ) {D : Set ℂ}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) : coarseMeasure b δ D = ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ D)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarse_mass_mul_le
statement:
lemma coarse_mass_mul_le {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    δ^(2*α) * (∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => δ^2 ≤ (b d).size), (b d).mass) ≤
      errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_lipschitz
statement:
lemma corrected_lipschitz {F : ℂ → ℂ} {L M R H : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith L F)
    (hM : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) (x z : ℂ)
    (hR : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ R) (hH : ‖(star (z-x))⁻¹‖ ≤ H) :
    LipschitzWith (L+H*(R*L+M)) (fun y => correction x z y * F y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_pairing_cap
statement:
lemma corrected_pairing_cap {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {D : Set ℂ}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1)
    (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∫ y, correction x z y*F y*b y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*(∫ y, ‖b y‖)+7*(∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖b y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_bounded
statement:
lemma correction_bounded {x z y : ℂ} (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hy : ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) : ‖correction x z y‖ ≤ 7

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_cap_bound
OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_eq
statement:
lemma correction_eq {x z y : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ x) :
    correction x z y = star (z-y) / star (z-x)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.densityMeasure_apply
statement:
lemma densityMeasure_apply {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {D : Set ℂ}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) : densityMeasure b D = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in D, ‖b y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.densityMeasure_finite
statement: lemma densityMeasure_finite {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) : IsFiniteMeasure (densityMeasure b)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.densityMeasure_univ
statement:
lemma densityMeasure_univ {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) :
    densityMeasure b univ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖b y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.errorPrice_nonneg
statement:
lemma errorPrice_nonneg {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (α : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.fine_pairing_bound
statement:
lemma fine_pairing_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) :
    ‖∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => (b d).size < δ^2), ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ)*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.fine_size_sum_le
statement:
lemma fine_size_sum_le {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hα : α ≤ 1)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => (b d).size < δ^2), (b d).size*(b d).mass) ≤
      δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.increment_bound
statement:
lemma increment_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      coarseMass b δ D+(L : ℝ)*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.integrable_lip_mul
OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.lip_cancellation
statement:
lemma lip_cancellation {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) (hzero : ∫ y, b y = 0)
    {L : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) (z : ℂ) {s : ℝ}
    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ y, b y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ s) :
    ‖∫ y, F y * b y‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * s * ∫ y, ‖b y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.min_one_le_rpow
statement:
lemma min_one_le_rpow {a α : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) :
    min 1 a ≤ a ^ α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.moment_correction
statement:
lemma moment_correction {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (x z : ℂ)
    (hF : Integrable (fun y => F y*b y))
    (hM : Integrable (fun y => star (y-x)*F y*b y))
    (hzero : ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*b y = 0) :
    (∫ y, F y*b y) = ∫ y, (1-star (y-x)/star (z-x))*F y*b y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.norm_correction
statement:
lemma norm_correction {x z y : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ x) :
    ‖correction x z y‖ = ‖y-z‖ / ‖z-x‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.pairing_majorant
statement:
lemma pairing_majorant {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {A : Set ℂ}
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (c d : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ c + d*A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) :
    ‖∫ y, F y*b y‖ ≤ c*(∫ y, ‖b y‖)+d*(∫ y in A, ‖b y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.piece_discount
statement:
lemma piece_discount {Cs α δ C : ℝ} (b : ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hLC : (L : ℝ) * Cs ≤ C / δ) :
    ‖∫ y, F y * b.density y‖ ≤ C * (b.size / δ) ^ α * b.mass

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.position_lipschitz
statement:
lemma position_lipschitz {F : ℂ → ℂ} {L M R : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith L F)
    (hM : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) (x : ℂ)
    (hR : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ R) :
    LipschitzWith (R*L+M) (fun y => star (y-x) * F y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.square_rpow
statement:
lemma square_rpow {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (α : ℝ) :
    (δ^2)^α = δ^(2*α)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.supported_pairing
statement:
lemma supported_pairing {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) {D : Set ℂ}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1)
    (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) :
    ‖∫ y, F y*b y‖ ≤ ∫ y in D, ‖b y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.total_pairing_discount
statement:
lemma total_pairing_discount {Cs α δ C : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hLC : (L : ℝ)*Cs ≤ C/δ) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤ C/δ^α*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.lintegral_shellMass
OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurableSet_shellPairs
statement:
lemma measurableSet_shellPairs (r δ : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ thinShell p.1 r δ}

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.measurable_shellMass
statement:
lemma measurable_shellMass (ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (r δ : ℝ) :
    Measurable (shellMass ν r δ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shellMass_exception
statement:
lemma shellMass_exception (ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {r δ U : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hr : δ ≤ r) (hU : 0 < U) :
    MeasurableSet {x | ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ shellMass ν r δ x} ∧
    volume {x | ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ shellMass ν r δ x} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*r*δ)*ν univ / ENNReal.ofReal U

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_symm
statement: lemma shell_symm (x y : ℂ) (r δ : ℝ) : y ∈ thinShell x r δ ↔ x ∈ thinShell y r δ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.thinShell_eq_diff
statement:
lemma thinShell_eq_diff {x : ℂ} {r δ : ℝ} :
    thinShell x r δ = Metric.closedBall x (r+δ) \ Metric.ball x (r-δ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.thinShell_subset_endpoint
statement:
lemma thinShell_subset_endpoint {x : ℂ} {r a δ : ℝ} (hra : |r-a| ≤ δ) :
    thinShell x r δ ⊆ thinShell x a (2*δ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_thinShell
statement:
lemma volume_thinShell (x : ℂ) {r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hr : δ ≤ r) :
    volume (thinShell x r δ) = ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*r*δ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.complex_kernel_bound
statement:
lemma complex_kernel_bound {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x y : ℂ) :
    ‖(kernel k x y : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.complex_kernel_lipschitz
statement:
lemma complex_kernel_lipschitz {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x : ℂ) :
    LipschitzWith M (fun y => (kernel k x y : ℂ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.difference_bound
OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.difference_support
statement:
lemma difference_support {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0}
    (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N)
    (hεδ : ε ≤ δ) (x y : ℂ) (h : (kernel l x y : ℂ) - kernel k x y ≠ 0) :
    |‖y-x‖-r| ≤ δ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_le_one
statement:
lemma kernel_le_one {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x y : ℂ) :
    kernel k x y ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.kernel_nonneg
statement:
lemma kernel_nonneg {a b : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity a b M) (x y : ℂ) :
    0 ≤ kernel k x y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tendsto_kernel
statement:
lemma tendsto_kernel {r : ℝ} {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {M : ℕ → ℝ≥0}
    (k : ∀ n, RadiusDensity (r-δ n) (r+δ n) (M n))
    (hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0)) (x y : ℂ) (hy : ‖y-x‖ ≠ r) :
    Tendsto (fun n => kernel (k n) x y) atTop
      (𝓝 ((Metric.ball x r).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskKernels.tendsto_kernel_pairing
statement:
lemma tendsto_kernel_pairing {r : ℝ} {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {M : ℕ → ℝ≥0}
    (k : ∀ n, RadiusDensity (r-δ n) (r+δ n) (M n))
    (hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0)) (x : ℂ) {b : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*b y) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, b y))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.exists_admissible_width
statement:
lemma exists_admissible_width : ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ δ₀ ≤ 1/4 ∧
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₀ → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.ratio_norm_lt
statement: lemma ratio_norm_lt {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) : ‖(1/2 : ℝ)^p‖ < 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.summable_width_rpow
statement:
lemma summable_width_rpow {δ p : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Summable (fun n => (width δ n)^p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.tendsto_width
statement: lemma tendsto_width (δ : ℝ) : Tendsto (width δ) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.tsum_width_rpow
statement:
lemma tsum_width_rpow {δ p : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∑' n, (width δ n)^p) = δ^p / (1-(1/2 : ℝ)^p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.width_antitone
statement: lemma width_antitone {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) : Antitone (width δ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.width_le
statement: lemma width_le {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (n : ℕ) : width δ n ≤ δ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.width_pos
statement: lemma width_pos {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (n : ℕ) : 0 < width δ n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.width_rpow
statement:
lemma width_rpow {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (width δ n)^p = δ^p*((1/2 : ℝ)^p)^n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.width_succ
statement: lemma width_succ (δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : width δ (n+1) = width δ n / 2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_increment_bound
statement:
lemma corrected_increment_bound {Cs α δ ρ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hzero : ∑ d, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b d).density y = 0) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+7*coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z ρ)+
      ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.integrable_bounded_pairing
statement:
lemma integrable_bounded_pairing {b F : ℂ → ℂ} (hb : Integrable b)
    (hF : AEStronglyMeasurable F) {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) :
    Integrable (fun y => F y*b y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.position_bound
statement:
lemma position_bound {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (x : ℂ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hR : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ R) :
    ∀ y, ‖star (y-x)*F y‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_step
statement:
theorem size_step {Cs α δ ρ U : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ^2/1600) (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*δ/ρ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*δ/ρ^2)))*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, ∀ (L : ℝ≥0) (F : ℂ → ℂ),
        LipschitzWith L F → (∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ thinShell x r δ) →
        (U ≤ coarseMass b δ (thinShell x r δ) →
          (∑ d, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b d).density y) = 0) →
        ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
          2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+14*U+
            ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.active_away_from_endpoints
statement:
lemma active_away_from_endpoints (ν : Measure ℂ) {x : ℂ} {δ U r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∉ endpointFailure ν δ U) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (ha : ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ ν (thinShell x r δ)) :
    1+δ ≤ r ∧ r+δ ≤ 2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.endpoint_failure_bound
statement:
lemma endpoint_failure_bound (ν : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {δ U : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδq : δ ≤ 1/4) (hU : 0 < U) :
    MeasurableSet (endpointFailure ν δ U) ∧
    volume (endpointFailure ν δ U) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (24*Real.pi*δ)*ν univ/ENNReal.ofReal U

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.endpoint_kernel
statement:
lemma endpoint_kernel {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) {x : ℂ} {r δ : ℝ}
    (hr : EndpointRadius g x r) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ ≤ 1/4) :
    ∃ k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) ⟨216/δ, by positivity⟩,
      (1+δ ≤ r ∧ r+δ ≤ 2 →
        (∫ y, kernel k x y • (star (y-x)*gradient g y)) = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.endpoint_power_identity
statement:
lemma endpoint_power_identity {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    δ * δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ)) / δ^(1/10 : ℝ) = δ^(22/25 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.endpoint_tail_scaled
statement:
lemma endpoint_tail_scaled {A t δ M : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hM : M ≤ A*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ))) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (24*Real.pi*δ)*ENNReal.ofReal M / ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (24*Real.pi*(A/t)*δ^(9/25 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.shell_tail_scaled
statement:
lemma shell_tail_scaled {A t δ M : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : M ≤ A*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ))) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (156*δ/δ^(1/5 : ℝ))*ENNReal.ofReal M*ENNReal.ofReal M) +
    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
      ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*δ/(δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*ENNReal.ofReal M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (156*(A/t)^2*δ^(14/25 : ℝ)+2400*Real.pi*(A/t)*δ^(9/25 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.ball_pairing_decomposition
statement:
lemma ball_pairing_decomposition {Cs r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (x : ℂ) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hr : r ≤ 3)
    (hh : ∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = h y) :
    (∑ j, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b j).density y) = ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, h y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.moment_difference_decomposition
statement:
lemma moment_difference_decomposition {Cs r δ ε : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N) (x : ℂ) {h : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3)
    (hh : ∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = h y)
    (hk : (∫ y, kernel k x y • (star (y-x)*h y)) = 0)
    (hl : (∫ y, kernel l x y • (star (y-x)*h y)) = 0) :
    (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*(b j).density y) = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_endpoint_raw
statement:
theorem size_endpoint_raw {Cs d t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*width d n/(width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*width d n/((width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        ENNReal.ofReal (24*Real.pi*width d n)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)/
          ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E,
        (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
        ∀ r, EndpointRadius g x r →
        ‖∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y‖ ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          (16+4538*Cs)*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_sequence
statement:
theorem size_sequence {Cs d t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*width d n/(width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*width d n/((width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ))) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ∀ k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
          ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩,
        (∀ n, t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ) ≤ coarseMass b (width d n) (thinShell x r (width d n)) →
          (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*((kernel (k (n+1)) x y : ℂ)-kernel (k n) x y)*(b j).density y) = 0) →
        ‖∑ j, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b j).density y‖ ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          (16+4538*Cs)*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

      (156*(A/t)^2*(width d n)^(14/25 : ℝ)+2424*Real.pi*(A/t)*(width d n)^(9/25 : ℝ))) =
    ENNReal.ofReal (156*(A/t)^2*d^(14/25 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(14/25 : ℝ))+

      (g : ℂ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
      ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧

      ∀ g : ℂ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g →
      ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_corrected_cap
statement:
lemma cone_corrected_cap {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {K L : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hL : AEStronglyMeasurable L)
    (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1)
    (hL0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ L y) (hL1 : ∀ y, L y ≤ 1)
    {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hsupp : ∀ y, L y-K y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)

    ‖∫ y, correction x z y*((L y : ℂ)-K y)*a y‖ ≤

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_error_bound

    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+7*coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z ρ)+
      ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_gap_cap
statement:
lemma negative_gap_cap {e : ℂ} {κ B ρ H : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {K L : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hL : AEStronglyMeasurable L)
    (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1)
    (hL0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ L y) (hL1 : ∀ y, L y ≤ 1)
    {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hsupp : ∀ y, L y-K y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (x z : ℂ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hcap : (∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖a.density y‖) ≤ H)
    {p q R : ℂ} (hp : ‖p‖ ≤ B) (hq : ‖q‖ ≤ B)
    (hneg : inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q) < 0)
    (hcor : ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q)-((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p) =
      (∫ y, correction x z y*((L y : ℂ)-K y)*a.density y)+R) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q)) ≤
      max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p))+
        4*ρ*(B/κ)+7*H+‖R‖
