name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_negative_le_error
statement:
lemma cone_negative_le_error {e : ℂ} {κ : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {K : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1) (p : ℂ) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p)) ≤ ‖p‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_gap
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_gap {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x z : ℂ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j < n)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hcap : coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤
      2*(t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ)))
    (hsmall : ∀ i, j < i → i < n → coarseMass b (width d i) (thinShell x r (width d i)) ≤
      t*(width d i)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)-kernel (k j) x y)*(b v).density y‖ ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_integrable
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_integrable {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (x z : ℂ)
    (hr : r+δ ≤ 3) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) :
    Integrable (fun y => correction x z y*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N) (x z : ℂ)
    (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) :
    (∫ y, correction x z y*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)-
      (∫ y, correction x z y*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y) =
      ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correcting_pairing
statement:
lemma correcting_pairing {a F : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    (hF : AEStronglyMeasurable F) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (x z : ℂ)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    (∫ y, correction x z y*F y*a y) = (∫ y, F y*a y) -
      (star (z-x))⁻¹*(∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.general_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma general_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {u v u' v' : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity u v M) (l : RadiusDensity u' v' N) (x : ℂ) :
    (∫ y, (kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)-(∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y) =
      ∫ y, ((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.general_moment_integrable
statement:
lemma general_moment_integrable {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (x : ℂ) (hr : r+δ ≤ 3) :
    Integrable (fun y => star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.inactive_kernel_distance
statement:
lemma inactive_kernel_distance {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hsmall : coarseMass b (width d n) (thinShell x r (width d n)) ≤ t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    dist (∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y)
      (∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel (k (n+1)) x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.interior_mass_le_kernel
statement:
lemma interior_mass_le_kernel {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) M) (x : ℂ) (hεδ : ε ≤ δ) :
    (∫ y in Metric.ball x (r-δ), ‖a y‖) ≤ ∫ y, kernel k x y*‖a y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.kernel_error_bound
statement:
lemma kernel_error_bound {Cs δ r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) ⟨216/δ, by positivity⟩) (x : ℂ) :
    ‖∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y‖ ≤
      (1+216*Cs)/δ^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.kernel_gap_errors
statement:
lemma kernel_gap_errors {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j < n)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, j < i → i < n → coarseMass b (width d i) (thinShell x r (width d i)) ≤
      t*(width d i)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    let B := (2*(1+216*Cs)+(16+4538*Cs)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)))*t*(width d j)^(-(1/50 : ℝ))
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, (kernel (k j) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y‖ ≤ B ∧
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.moment_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma moment_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N) (x : ℂ) (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) :
    (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)-
      (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y) =
      ∫ y, star (y-x)*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.scaled_corrected_active
statement:
lemma scaled_corrected_active {Cs δ t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ 648/δ) (x z : ℂ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hcap : coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤ 2*(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ))) :
    ‖∑ j, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b j).density y‖ ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.scaled_corrected_inactive
statement:
lemma scaled_corrected_inactive {Cs δ t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ 648/δ) (hsmall : coarseMass b δ D ≤ t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ))
    (x z : ℂ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∑ j, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b j).density y‖ ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.scaled_ordinary_inactive
statement:
lemma scaled_ordinary_inactive {Cs δ t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ 648/δ) (hsmall : coarseMass b δ D ≤ t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    ‖∑ j, ∫ y, F y*(b j).density y‖ ≤ (16+4538*Cs)*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.total_correction
statement:
lemma total_correction {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) {a F : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    (hF : AEStronglyMeasurable F) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (x z : ℂ)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hzero : (∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b j).density y) = 0) :
    (∫ y, F y*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, F y*(b j).density y) =
      (∫ y, correction x z y*F y*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b j).density y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMoments.neighborhood_kernel
statement:
lemma neighborhood_kernel {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) {x : ℂ} {r δ : ℝ}
    (hr : NeighborhoodRadius g x r) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ ≤ 1/4) :
    ∃ k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) ⟨216/δ, by positivity⟩,
      (∫ y, kernel k x y • (star (y-x)*gradient g y)) = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.directionGapConstant_ge
statement:
lemma directionGapConstant_ge {Cs κ : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    16+4538*Cs ≤ directionGapConstant Cs κ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.directionGapConstant_pos
statement:
lemma directionGapConstant_pos {Cs κ : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    0 < directionGapConstant Cs κ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.direction_cap_scale
statement:
lemma direction_cap_scale {Cs κ δ t : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    4*δ^(1/5 : ℝ)*((errorGapConstant Cs*t*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ)))/κ)+14*(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ))+
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)) ≤
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.direction_shell_tail_scaled
statement:
lemma direction_shell_tail_scaled {A t δ M H : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hM : M ≤ A*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ))) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (156*δ/δ^(1/5 : ℝ))*ENNReal.ofReal M*ENNReal.ofReal M) +
    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
      ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal
        (2*(200*δ/(δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)*(1+(H*t*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ)))/(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))))*ENNReal.ofReal M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((1+H)*(156*(A/t)^2*δ^(14/25 : ℝ)+2424*Real.pi*(A/t)*δ^(9/25 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.direction_start_identity
statement:
lemma direction_start_identity {Cs κ A t : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (1+216*Cs)/(A/t)^(1/100 : ℝ)*A+
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*(A/t)^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)) =
    t*((1+216*Cs)*(A/t)^(99/100 : ℝ)+
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*(A/t)^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.errorGapConstant_pos
statement: lemma errorGapConstant_pos {Cs : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) : 0 < errorGapConstant Cs

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.exists_direction_parameters
statement:
lemma exists_direction_parameters (Cs κ : ℝ) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ d₀ ≤ 1/4 ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d₀ → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d₀ →
        (1+216*Cs)*δ^(99/100 : ℝ)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)) ≤ 1)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_raw
statement:
theorem direction_raw {e : ℂ} {κ Cs d t : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, directionShellBound b κ t (width d n) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E,
        (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a.density y+∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
        ∀ r, NeighborhoodRadius g x r →
        max 0 (-inner ℝ e (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y)) ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_sequence
statement:
theorem direction_sequence {e : ℂ} {κ Cs d t : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, directionShellBound b κ t (width d n) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ∀ k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
          ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩,
        (∀ n, (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*a.density y)+
          (∑ v, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y) = 0) →
        max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a.density y)+
          (∑ v, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b v).density y))) ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_sequence_point
statement:
lemma direction_sequence_point {Cs κ d t r : ℝ} {e : ℂ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ n, (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*a.density y)+
      (∑ v, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y) = 0)
    (hcap : ∀ j, t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ) ≤ coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j)) →
      (∫ y in Metric.ball x (r-width d j), ‖a.density y‖) ≤
        (errorGapConstant Cs/κ)*t*(width d j)^(-(1/50 : ℝ)) →
      ∃ z ∈ thinShell x r (width d j),
        (∫ y in thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ)), ‖a.density y‖)+
        coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤
          2*(t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ))) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a.density y)+(∑ v, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b v).density y))) ≤
      (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.mixed_ball_pairing_decomposition
statement:
lemma mixed_ball_pairing_decomposition {Cs r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a) (x : ℂ) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hr : r ≤ 3)
    (hh : ∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a y+∑ j, (b j).density y = h y) :
    (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b j).density y) =
      ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, h y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.mixed_moment_pairing_decomposition
statement:
lemma mixed_moment_pairing_decomposition {Cs r δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a) {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (x : ℂ) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hr : r+δ ≤ 3)
    (hh : ∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a y+∑ j, (b j).density y = h y) :
    (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) =
      ∫ y, kernel k x y • (star (y-x)*h y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMaximalTools.truncation_layer_integral
statement:
theorem truncation_layer_integral {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    [SFinite μ] {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0,
      (∫⁻ x, if t < 2*f x then ENNReal.ofReal (f x) else 0 ∂μ)*ENNReal.ofReal (t^(p-2))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2^(p-1)/(p-1))*(∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x)^p) ∂μ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMaximalTools.truncation_layer_single
statement:
lemma truncation_layer_single {b p : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hp : 1 < p) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, (if t < 2*b then ENNReal.ofReal b else 0)*ENNReal.ofReal (t^(p-2))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2^(p-1)/(p-1))*ENNReal.ofReal (b^p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMaximalTools.volume_dilate_five

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMaximalTools.volume_disk_real
statement:

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskMaximalTools.weak_bound
statement:
theorem weak_bound {ν : Measure ℂ} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    volume {x : ℂ | ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal a * volume (ball x r) ≤ ν (ball x r)} ≤
      (25 / ENNReal.ofReal a) * ν univ

    (hr : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 < r i) (hR : ∀ i ∈ t, r i ≤ R)
    (hav : ∀ i ∈ t, ENNReal.ofReal a * volume (ball (x i) (r i)) ≤ ν (ball (x i) (r i))) :
    volume (⋃ i ∈ t, ball (x i) (r i)) ≤ (25 / ENNReal.ofReal a) * ν univ

      ENNReal.ofReal (a/2)*volume (ball x r)) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_majorant
statement:
theorem direction_majorant {Cs κ : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {e : ℂ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
      (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      ∀ g : ℂ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
      ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
        (∫⁻ x in Q, F x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*errorPrice b (1/100)) ∧
        ∀ x, (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a.density y+∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
          ∀ r, NeighborhoodRadius g x r →
            ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (-inner ℝ e (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y))) ≤ F x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_tail
statement:
theorem direction_tail {Cs κ : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 1 ≤ L ∧ ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {e : ℂ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
      (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      0 < errorPrice b (1/100) → ∀ t : ℝ, L*errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t →
      ∀ g : ℂ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g →
      ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
        volume E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (directionTailConstant Cs κ*(errorPrice b (1/100)/t)^(34/25 : ℝ)) ∧
        ∀ x ∉ E,
          (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a.density y+∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
          ∀ r, NeighborhoodRadius g x r →
            max 0 (-inner ℝ e (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y)) ≤ t

lemma error_recurrence (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (f : ι → α → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (q : ι) (x : α) :
    refined w f (k+1) q x-roots μ w f (k+1) q x = errors μ w f (k+1) q x+
      ∑ s, w k q s*(refined w f k s x-roots μ w f k s x)

    (∫ x, |errors μ w f (k+1) q x| ∂μ) ≤
      (∑ s, w k q s*|∫ x, refined w f k s x ∂μ|)-|∫ x, refined w f (k+1) q x ∂μ|

statement:
theorem positive_residual {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {h : α → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h μ) (hc : 0 ≤ ∫ x, h x ∂μ) :
    ∃ ρ : α → ℝ, Integrable ρ μ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧
      (∀ x, ρ x ≤ max (h x) 0) ∧ (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ) = ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, |h x-ρ x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |h x| ∂μ) - ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∀ x, h x = 0 → ρ x = 0)

OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.refinement_residual
statement:
theorem refinement_residual {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ρ : ι → α → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, Integrable (ρ i) μ) :
    ∃ R β : α → ℝ, Integrable R μ ∧ Integrable β μ ∧
      (∀ x, (∑ i, w i*ρ i x) = R x+β x) ∧
      (∫ x, R x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ) ∧
      (∫ x, β x ∂μ) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x, |R x| ∂μ) = |∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)| ∧
      (∫ x, |β x| ∂μ) ≤
        (∑ i, w i*(∫ x, |ρ i x| ∂μ))-|∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ R x) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ i, w i*ρ i x = 0) → R x = 0 ∧ β x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.residual_split
statement:
theorem residual_split {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {h : α → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h μ) :
    ∃ ρ β : α → ℝ, Integrable ρ μ ∧ Integrable β μ ∧
      (∀ x, h x = ρ x+β x) ∧ (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ) = ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, β x ∂μ) = 0 ∧ (∫ x, |ρ x| ∂μ) = |∫ x, h x ∂μ| ∧
      (∫ x, |β x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |h x| ∂μ)-|∫ x, h x ∂μ| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∫ x, h x ∂μ) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧
      ((∫ x, h x ∂μ) < 0 → ∀ x, ρ x ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, h x = 0 → ρ x = 0 ∧ β x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.root_spec
statement:
lemma root_spec {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    Integrable (root μ f) μ ∧
      (∫ x, root μ f x ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, |root μ f x| ∂μ) = |∫ x, f x ∂μ| ∧
      (∫ x, |f x-root μ f x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |f x| ∂μ)-|∫ x, f x ∂μ| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ root μ f x) ∧
      ((∫ x, f x ∂μ) < 0 → ∀ x, root μ f x ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, f x = 0 → root μ f x = 0)

theorem telescoped_decomposition [DecidableEq ι] (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (f : ι → α → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ k q s, Λ k k q s = if q = s then 1 else 0)
    (hstep : ∀ k j q s, j ≤ k → Λ (k+1) j q s = ∑ a, w k q a*Λ k j a s)
    (k : ℕ) (q : ι) (x : α) :
    refined w f k q x = roots μ w f k q x +
      ∑ j ∈ range (k+1), ∑ s, Λ k j q s*errors μ w f j s x

theorem switchRow_distance [DecidableEq ι] (old : ι) (sample sample' : Law κ)
    (target : κ → ι) (p : κ → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) :
    l1dist (switchRow old sample target p hp0 hp1) (switchRow old sample' target p hp0 hp1)
      ≤ 2*∑ z, |sample z-sample' z| *p z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRow_formula
statement:
lemma switchRow_formula [DecidableEq ι] (old : ι) (sample : Law κ) (target : κ → ι)
    (p : κ → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (j : ι) :
    switchRow old sample target p hp0 hp1 j =
      delta old j+∑ z, sample z*p z*(delta (target z) j-delta old j)

theorem pair_defect_bound {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (w a : ι → ℝ) (θ : ι → E) (n : E) (A : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hθ : ∀ i, ‖θ i‖ = 1)
    (href : A • n = ∑ i, (w i*a i) • θ i)
    {q s : ι} (hwaq : 1/4 ≤ w q) (hwas : 9/64 ≤ w s) (has : a q ≤ a s) :
    a q*‖θ q-θ s‖^2 ≤ 48*((∑ i, w i*a i)-A)

    (href : A • n = ∑ i, (w i*a i) • θ i) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.cancelled_potential_lp
statement:
theorem cancelled_potential_lp {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {β : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hψm : Measurable ψ) {R X B L a : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hβ : Integrable β) (hβs : ∀ y, β y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ a) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪cancelledGreen ψ z a x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    (ENNReal.ofReal ((2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)*(4*Real.pi*(4*a)^(1/2:ℝ))) +
    ENNReal.ofReal (((8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)*a)^(3/2:ℝ) *
        (2*Real.pi/(2*a)))) * (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.column_scaling
statement:
lemma column_scaling {K D a : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (ha : 0 < a) :

      (D*a)^(3/2:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi/(2*a)) =
      (8*Real.pi*K^(3/2:ℝ)+Real.pi*D^(3/2:ℝ))*a^(1/2:ℝ)

    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hβ : Integrable β) (hzero : ∫ y, β y = 0)

    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((8*Real.pi*(2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)+
      Real.pi*(8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)^(3/2:ℝ))*a^(1/2:ℝ)) *

    {ψ g : ℂ → ℝ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) {D R X Y B : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) (hψ1 : ∫ z, ψ z = 1)
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hRX : R ≤ X) (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hXY : 0 < X+Y)
    (β : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (hβ : ∀ i, Integrable (β i))
    (hβs : ∀ i y, β i y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ Y)
    (hdecomp : ∀ᵐ y, ‖y‖ ≤ X → gradient g y = ∑ i, β i y) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},

lemma lipschitz_hat {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.norm_le_two_boxNorm
statement: lemma norm_le_two_boxNorm (x : ℂ) : ‖x‖ ≤ 2*boxNorm x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.scalarMass_le_integral
statement:
lemma scalarMass_le_integral {h : ℂ → ℂ} (r : ℝ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    scalarMass h r p ≤ ∫ y, hat r p y * ‖h y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.scale_index_bound
statement:
lemma scale_index_bound {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.scale_pos
statement: lemma scale_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (k : ℕ) : 0 < scale r k

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.scale_succ
statement: lemma scale_succ (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : scale r (k+1) = 2*scale r k

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.step_locality
statement:
lemma step_locality {p q : ℤ × ℤ} (hpq : 0 < step p q) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    boxNorm (point (r/2) q-point r p) ≤ r/2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.sum_scalarMass_le
statement:
lemma sum_scalarMass_le {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h) (r : ℝ) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    ∑ p ∈ S, scalarMass h r p ≤ ∫ y, ‖h y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.support_hat_subset
statement:
lemma support_hat_subset {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Function.support (hat r p) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (point r p) (2*r)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LipschitzWith.integrable_gradient
statement:
theorem integrable_gradient (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (hc : HasCompactSupport f) :
    Integrable (gradient f) μ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LipschitzWith.integral_fderiv_mul_eq_neg
statement:
theorem integral_fderiv_mul_eq_neg (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (hg : LipschitzWith K g)
    (hgc : HasCompactSupport g) (v : E) :
    (∫ x, fderiv ℝ f x v * g x ∂μ) = -∫ x, fderiv ℝ g x v * f x ∂μ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LipschitzWith.integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg
statement:
theorem integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (hg : LipschitzWith K g)
    (hgc : HasCompactSupport g) (v : E) :
    (∫ x, f x * fderiv ℝ g x v ∂μ) = -∫ x, inner ℝ (gradient f x) v * g x ∂μ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LipschitzWith.locallyIntegrable_gradient
statement:
theorem locallyIntegrable_gradient (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    LocallyIntegrable (gradient f) μ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.activeIndices_card
statement: lemma activeIndices_card (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) : (activeIndices r x).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.coeff_nonneg
statement: lemma coeff_nonneg (N d : ℕ) (p q : Grid N) : 0 ≤ coeff N d p q

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.densityDefect_nonneg
statement:
lemma densityDefect_nonneg {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hs : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    0 ≤ densityDefect N r h k q

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.densityError_cost
statement:
lemma densityError_cost {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hs : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    (∫ x, |densityError N r h k q x|) ≤ 2*densityDefect N r h k q

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.densityError_integrable
statement:
lemma densityError_integrable {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    Integrable (densityError N r h k q)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.densityError_zero_mass
statement:
lemma densityError_zero_mass {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    (∫ x, densityError N r h k q x) = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.densityRoot_integrable
statement:
lemma densityRoot_integrable {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    Integrable (densityRoot N r h k q)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.discount_recurrence
statement:
lemma discount_recurrence (ρ : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (k+2), ρ^(k+1-j)*a j) =
      a (k+1)+ρ*(∑ j ∈ range (k+1), ρ^(k-j)*a j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.hat_zero_of_not_active
statement:
lemma hat_zero_of_not_active (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p ∉ activeIndices r x) :
    hat r p x = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_add
statement:
lemma interpolate_add (r : ℝ) (f g : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    interpolate r (fun p => f p+g p) x = interpolate r f x+interpolate r g x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_const
statement: lemma interpolate_const (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (c : ℝ) : interpolate r (fun _ => c) x = c

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_eq_sum
statement:
lemma interpolate_eq_sum (r : ℝ) (f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (x : ℂ)
    (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (hS : activeIndices r x ⊆ S) :
    interpolate r f x = ∑ p ∈ S, hat r p x*f p

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_finset_sum
statement:
lemma interpolate_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (r : ℝ)
    (f : ι → ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    interpolate r (fun p => ∑ i ∈ s, f i p) x = ∑ i ∈ s, interpolate r (f i) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_le_const
statement:
lemma interpolate_le_const (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) {f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hf : ∀ p, f p ≤ c) :
    interpolate r f x ≤ c

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_lipschitz
statement:
theorem interpolate_lipschitz {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ p, |f p| ≤ B) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (16*B/r)) (interpolate r f)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_mono
statement:
lemma interpolate_mono (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) {f g : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (h : ∀ p, f p ≤ g p) :
    interpolate r f x ≤ interpolate r g x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_mul_const
statement:
lemma interpolate_mul_const (r : ℝ) (f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) (c : ℝ) :
    interpolate r (fun p => f p*c) x = interpolate r f x*c

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_nonneg
statement:
lemma interpolate_nonneg (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) {f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ p, 0 ≤ f p) :
    0 ≤ interpolate r f x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_sub
statement:
lemma interpolate_sub (r : ℝ) (f g : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    interpolate r (fun p => f p-g p) x = interpolate r f x-interpolate r g x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.pieces_integrable
statement:
lemma pieces_integrable {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h) (r : ℝ) (q : Grid N) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.step_support
statement:
lemma step_support {r : ℝ} (_hr : 0 < r) {p q : ℤ × ℤ} (hw : step p q ≠ 0) :
    Function.support (hat r q) ⊆ Function.support (hat (2*r) p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.summable_weighted_hat
statement:
lemma summable_weighted_hat (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) :
    Summable (fun p => hat r p x*f p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.triangle_discount_bound
statement:
lemma triangle_discount_bound {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n+1), ∑ j ∈ range (k+1), ρ^(k-j)*a j) ≤
      (1-ρ)⁻¹*∑ j ∈ range (n+1), a j

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.continuous_boxNorm
statement: lemma continuous_boxNorm : Continuous boxNorm

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.hat_at_point
statement:
lemma hat_at_point {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (p q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    hat r p (point r q) = if p=q then 1 else 0

OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_congr_on
statement:
lemma interpolate_congr_on (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) {f g : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ p, hat r p x ≠ 0 → f p = g p) : interpolate r f x = interpolate r g x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.interpolate_mono_on
statement:
lemma interpolate_mono_on (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) {f g : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ}

OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.local_neighborhood
statement:
lemma local_neighborhood {r : ℝ} {q x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.truncate_le
statement:
lemma truncate_le {r B : ℝ} {q : ℂ} {p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hp : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) (z : ℤ × ℤ) :
    truncate r q p z ≤ B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.truncate_nonneg
statement:
lemma truncate_nonneg (r : ℝ) (q : ℂ) {p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (z : ℤ × ℤ) :
    0 ≤ truncate r q p z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.amplitude_le_one
statement: lemma amplitude_le_one (τ d : ℝ) : amplitude τ d ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.amplitude_lipschitz
statement:
lemma amplitude_lipschitz {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal τ⁻¹) (amplitude τ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.amplitude_nonneg
statement: lemma amplitude_nonneg {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (d : ℝ) : 0 ≤ amplitude τ d

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.delta_diff_le_one
statement: lemma delta_diff_le_one (i j k : ι) : |delta i k-delta j k| ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.interpolate_const_mul
statement:
lemma interpolate_const_mul (r : ℝ) (f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) (c : ℝ) :
    interpolate r (fun p => c*f p) x = c*interpolate r f x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.norm_sub_sq_le_four
statement:
lemma norm_sub_sq_le_four {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (u v w : E) {A : ℝ}
    (hu : ‖u-w‖^2 ≤ A) (hv : ‖v-w‖^2 ≤ A) : ‖u-v‖^2 ≤ 4*A

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_compare
statement:
lemma probability_compare {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (d d' : ℝ) :
    probability τ d ≤ 2*probability τ d'+2*τ⁻¹^2*|d-d'|^2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_eq_square
statement:
lemma probability_eq_square {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (d : ℝ) :
    probability τ d = amplitude τ d^2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_eq_zero
statement: lemma probability_eq_zero {τ d : ℝ} (hd : d ≤ τ) : probability τ d = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_formula
statement:
lemma probability_formula (τ d : ℝ) :
    probability τ d = min 1 (τ^(-2:ℤ)*max (d-τ) 0^2)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_le_one
statement: lemma probability_le_one (τ d : ℝ) : probability τ d ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_le_rate_energy
statement:
lemma probability_le_rate_energy {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (n θ q y : ℂ) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hE : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → ‖Θ z-θ‖^2 ≤ E)
    (z : ℤ × ℤ) (hz : boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r) :
    probability τ ‖n-Θ z‖ ≤ 2*switchRate τ r Θ n y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_lt_one_iff
statement: lemma probability_lt_one_iff {τ d : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) : probability τ d < 1 ↔ d < 2*τ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_nonneg
statement: lemma probability_nonneg (τ d : ℝ) : 0 ≤ probability τ d

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.probability_norm_compare
OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_component_lipschitz
statement:
lemma spatialRow_component_lipschitz (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpB : ∀ z, p z ≤ B) (j : ι) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (16*B/r)) (fun x => spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_distance
statement:
lemma spatialRow_distance (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpB : ∀ z, p z ≤ B) (x y : ℂ) :
    l1dist (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(16*B/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_formula
statement:
lemma spatialRow_formula (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j =
      delta old j+interpolate r (fun z => p z*(delta (target z) j-delta old j)) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_local_derivative
statement:
lemma spatialRow_local_derivative (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {q x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r)
    (hpB : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) :
    r*∑ j : ι, ‖gradient (fun y => spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y j) x‖ ≤
      16*(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_local_distance
statement:
lemma spatialRow_local_distance (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {q x y : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hpB : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) :
    l1dist (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(16*B/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_truncate
statement:
lemma spatialRow_truncate (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {q x : ℂ}
    (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target (truncate r q p) (truncate_nonneg r q hp0)
      (truncate_le (by norm_num) (fun z _ => hp1 z)) r x j =
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialSwitchRow_local_derivative
statement:
lemma spatialSwitchRow_local_derivative {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (label : ι → ℂ) (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (old : ι)
    (θ q x y : ℂ) (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hE : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → ‖Θ z-θ‖^2 ≤ E) :
    r*∑ j : ι, ‖gradient (fun x => spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old x j) x‖ ≤
      16*(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(2*switchRate τ r Θ (label old) y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialSwitchRow_local_distance
statement:
lemma spatialSwitchRow_local_distance {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (label : ι → ℂ) (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (old : ι)
    (θ q x y : ℂ) (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hE : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → ‖Θ z-θ‖^2 ≤ E) :
    l1dist (spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old x) (spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*
        (16*(2*switchRate τ r Θ (label old) y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E)/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRate_le_one
statement:
lemma switchRate_le_one (τ r : ℝ) (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (n x : ℂ) :
    switchRate τ r Θ n x ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRate_local_compare
statement:
lemma switchRate_local_compare {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (n θ q x y : ℂ)
    (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hE : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → ‖Θ z-θ‖^2 ≤ E) :
    switchRate τ r Θ n x ≤ 2*switchRate τ r Θ n y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.switchRate_nonneg

lemma switchRate_nonneg (τ r : ℝ) (Θ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (n x : ℂ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DirectionNeighbors.energy_le_four
statement: lemma energy_le_four (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (q : ℤ × ℤ) : energy h r q ≤ 4

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DirectionNeighbors.energy_nonneg
statement: lemma energy_nonneg (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (q : ℤ × ℤ) : 0 ≤ energy h r q

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DirectionNeighbors.norm_theta

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DirectionNeighbors.worstVertex_near
statement:
lemma worstVertex_near {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DirectionNeighbors.worst_chosen_spec
statement:

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.hat_lower
statement:
lemma hat_lower {r a : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (ha : a ≤ 1) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : ℂ)
    (hx : boxNorm (x-point r p) ≤ a*r) : (1-a)^2 ≤ hat r p x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.nearParent_box
statement:
lemma nearParent_box {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    boxNorm (point r q-point (4096*r) (nearParent q)) ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)*(4096*r)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.nearParent_fiber_card
statement:
lemma nearParent_fiber_card (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (S.filter (fun q => nearParent q=p)).card ≤ 4097^2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.nearParent_hat_lower
statement:
lemma nearParent_hat_lower {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (q w : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hw : boxNorm (point r w-point r q) ≤ 500*r) :
    1/4 ≤ hat (scale r 12) (nearParent q) (point r q) ∧
    9/64 ≤ hat (scale r 12) (nearParent q) (point r w)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DyadicHats.nearParent_int_bound
statement: lemma nearParent_int_bound (j : ℤ) : |j-4096*((j+2048)/4096)| ≤ 2048

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.axes_inner
statement: lemma axes_inner {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) : inner ℝ (axis n 1) (axis n (-1)) = 1/2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.axis_norm
statement:
lemma axis_norm {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : s^2 = 1) :
    ‖axis n s‖ = 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.cone_algebra
statement:
theorem cone_algebra {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ 12*(inner ℝ n z + max 0 (-inner ℝ (axis n 1) z) +
      max 0 (-inner ℝ (axis n (-1)) z))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.coordinate_apply
statement:
lemma coordinate_apply (n z : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    coordinate n s z = (star n*z).re / Real.sqrt 3 + s*(star n*z).im

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.coordinate_norm_le
statement:
lemma coordinate_norm_le {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : |s| ≤ 1) (z : ℂ) :
    |coordinate n s z| ≤ 2 * ‖z‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.exists_palette
statement: lemma exists_palette : Nonempty Palette

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.expansion
statement:
lemma expansion {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (z : ℂ) :
    coordinate n 1 z • axis n 1 + coordinate n (-1) z • axis n (-1) = z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.good_of_close
statement: lemma good_of_close {n z : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hclose : ‖z-n‖ ≤ 1/10) : Good n z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.inner_axis
statement:
lemma inner_axis (n z : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (axis n s) z = Real.sqrt 3/2 * inner ℝ n z + s/2*inner ℝ (Complex.I*n) z

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.inner_im
statement: lemma inner_im (n z : ℂ) : inner ℝ (Complex.I*n) z = (star n*z).im

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.inner_quarter_self
statement: lemma inner_quarter_self {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) : inner ℝ (Complex.I*n) n = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.inner_re
statement: lemma inner_re (n z : ℂ) : inner ℝ n z = (star n*z).re

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.mul_star_of_unit
statement: lemma mul_star_of_unit {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) : n * star n = 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.norm_le_coords
statement:
lemma norm_le_coords {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ |inner ℝ n z|+|inner ℝ (Complex.I*n) z|

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.quantize_close
statement: lemma quantize_close (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : ‖z-(quantize z hz : ℂ)‖ < 1/2000

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.sqrt3_bounds
statement: lemma sqrt3_bounds : 3/2 ≤ Real.sqrt 3 ∧ Real.sqrt 3 ≤ 2

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.sqrt3_pos
statement: lemma sqrt3_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt 3

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeCoordinates.sqrt3_sq
statement: lemma sqrt3_sq : (Real.sqrt 3)^2 = 3

OAI.SignedDisk.ConeScalar.pair_cone
statement:
lemma pair_cone {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1) :
    (1/2:ℝ)*‖a • axis n 1+b • axis n (-1)‖ ≤ inner ℝ (axis n s)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeScalar.root_vector_integrable

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeScalar.scalar_integrable

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeScalar.scalar_mass
statement:
lemma scalar_mass {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h) (c : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (r : ℝ) (q : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (∫ y, hat r q y*c (h y)) = c (vectorMass h r q)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ConeScalar.scalar_support

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DirectionNeighbors.shifted_mass_bound

statement: lemma label_unit (n : Label) : ‖(n:ℂ)‖ = 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.marginal_bad_zero
statement:
theorem marginal_bad_zero (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r k)
    (q : ℤ × ℤ) {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point (r k) q) ≤ 50*r k)
    (hE : energy h (r k) q ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2) (n : Label)
    (hn : ¬Good (n:ℂ) (theta h (r k) q)) : marginal h r k x n = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.nearby_sample_close
statement:
lemma nearby_sample_close {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point r q) ≤ 50*r)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.retained_good
statement:

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.row_bad_zero
statement:
lemma row_bad_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)

    (hE : energy h r q ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2) (old n : Label)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.sampled_good
statement:
lemma sampled_good {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchChance_le_one
statement:
lemma switchChance_le_one (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : Label) (z : ℤ × ℤ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchChance_nonneg
statement:
lemma switchChance_nonneg (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : Label) (z : ℤ × ℤ) :

statement:
lemma target_close (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (z : ℤ × ℤ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.integrable_rescale
statement:
lemma integrable_rescale {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h) (p : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.integral_affine
statement:
lemma integral_affine (h : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ X : ℂ, h (p+r • X)) = (r^2)⁻¹ • ∫ y, h y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.integral_rescale
statement:
lemma integral_rescale (h : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    (∫ X, rescale p r h X) = r⁻¹ • ∫ y, h y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.mass_rescale
statement:
lemma mass_rescale (h : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∫ X, ‖rescale p r h X‖) = r⁻¹*(∫ y, ‖h y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.rescale_support
statement:
lemma rescale_support {h : ℂ → ℂ} {p z : ℂ} {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ t) (X : ℂ) (hX : rescale p r h X ≠ 0) :
    ‖X-r⁻¹ • (z-p)‖ ≤ t/r

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.coordinate_total_le
statement:
lemma coordinate_total_le {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h) {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : |s| ≤ 1) : (∫ x, |coordinate n s (h x)|) ≤ 2*(∫ x, ‖h x‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.rho_lt_one
statement: lemma rho_lt_one : rho < 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.rho_pos
statement: lemma rho_pos : 0 < rho

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.rootPrice_nonneg
statement:
lemma rootPrice_nonneg {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    0 ≤ rootPrice N r h k q

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.scalarPrice_nonneg
statement:
lemma scalarPrice_nonneg {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (q : Grid N) :
    0 ≤ scalarPrice N r h rho k q

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.scale_discount
statement:
lemma scale_discount {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {j k : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (scale r j / scale r k)^(1/100:ℝ) = rho^(k-j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.scale_ratio
statement:
lemma scale_ratio {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {j k : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    scale r j / scale r k = (1/2:ℝ)^(k-j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_mixture
statement:
lemma spatialRow_mixture (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j =
      interpolate r (fun z => (1-p z)*delta old j+p z*delta (target z) j) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_vanish
statement:
lemma spatialRow_vanish (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (j : ι)
    (hj : ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → (1-p z)*delta old j+p z*delta (target z) j = 0) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j = 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.ErrorPiece.mass_weight
statement:
lemma ErrorPiece.mass_weight {Cs : ℝ} (b : ErrorPiece Cs) {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) :
    (b.weight w).mass = w*b.mass

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_sum
statement:
lemma cone_sum {ι : Type*} {e : ℂ} {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → ℂ)
    (hv : ∀ i ∈ s, κ*‖v i‖ ≤ inner ℝ e (v i)) :
    κ*‖∑ i ∈ s, v i‖ ≤ inner ℝ e (∑ i ∈ s, v i)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PricePieces.errorPiece_mass
statement:
lemma errorPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (p : ℂ) (q : Grid N)
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : s^2 = 1) :
    (errorPiece hh hr k j hj p q n s).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*
      (2*densityDefect N r (fun x => coordinate n s (h x)) j q)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PricePieces.scale_le

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.badWeight_cases
statement: lemma badWeight_cases (a : ℂ) (n : Label) : badWeight a n = 0 ∨ badWeight a n = 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.badWeight_le_one
statement: lemma badWeight_le_one (a : ℂ) (n : Label) : badWeight a n ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.badWeight_nonneg
statement: lemma badWeight_nonneg (a : ℂ) (n : Label) : 0 ≤ badWeight a n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.law_drift
statement:
lemma law_drift {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point r q) ≤ 50*r)
    (hE : energy h r q ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2) {anchor : ℂ}
    (ha : ‖theta h r q-anchor‖ ≤ 1/800) (μ : Law Label) :
    expect (move μ (row h r x)) (badWeight anchor)+expect μ (rate h r x) =
      expect μ (badWeight anchor)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.rate_le_one
statement: lemma rate_le_one (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (n : Label) : rate h r x n ≤ 1

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.rate_nonneg
statement: lemma rate_nonneg (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (n : Label) : 0 ≤ rate h r x n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.row_drift
statement:
theorem row_drift {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point r q) ≤ 50*r)
    (hE : energy h r q ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2) {anchor : ℂ}
    (ha : ‖theta h r q-anchor‖ ≤ 1/800) (old : Label) :
    expect (row h r x old) (badWeight anchor)+rate h r x old = badWeight anchor old

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchCost_le_one

lemma switchCost_le_one (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchCost_nonneg
statement:
lemma switchCost_nonneg (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchCost_sum
statement:
theorem switchCost_sum (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ) (x : ℂ)
    (anchor : ℕ → ℂ) (exceptional : ℕ → Bool) {b m : ℕ} (hbm : b ≤ m)
    (hr : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, 0 < r (k+1))
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, boxNorm (x-point (r (k+1)) (q (k+1))) ≤ 50*r (k+1))
    (hE : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, exceptional (k+1) = false →
      energy h (r (k+1)) (q (k+1)) ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2)
    (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, exceptional (k+1) = false →
      anchor (k+1) = anchor k ∧ ‖theta h (r (k+1)) (q (k+1))-anchor k‖ ≤ 1/800) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, switchCost h r x (k+1)) ≤
      1+2*∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, if exceptional (k+1) then (1:ℝ) else 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualMarkTrees.active_length
statement:
lemma active_length {N : ℕ} (v : Grid N → ℂ) {k : ℕ} {b : ℝ} {q : Grid N}

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.expect_delta
statement: lemma expect_delta (i : ι) (f : ι → ℝ) : expect (delta i) f = f i

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_absorbing
statement:
lemma spatialRow_absorbing (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ)
    (b : ι → ℝ) (hb : b old = 0 ∨ b old = 1)
    (ht : ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → b (target z) = 0)
    (hz : b old = 0 → ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → p z = 0) :
    expect (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) b+interpolate r p x = b old

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_expect
statement:
lemma spatialRow_expect (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    expect (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) f =
      f old+interpolate r (fun z => p z*(f (target z)-f old)) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.activePath_valid
statement: lemma activePath_valid {t : Tree ι E} {p : List ι} (h : activePath t p) : validPath t p

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.active_append

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.anchor_step
statement:
lemma anchor_step (e : E) (δ : ℝ) (t : Tree ι E) (n : E) (p : List ι)
    (hp : validPath t p) {s : ℕ} (hs : s < p.length)
    (hm : markIndicator e δ t n (p.take (s+1)) = 0) :
    anchor e δ t n (p.take (s+1)) = anchor e δ t n (p.take s) ∧
      ‖direction e (vector (atPath t (p.take (s+1))))-anchor e δ t n (p.take s)‖ ≤ δ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.anchor_zero
statement:
lemma anchor_zero (e : E) (δ : ℝ) (t : Tree ι E) (n : E)
    (hm : markIndicator e δ t n [] = 0) :
    anchor e δ t n [] = n ∧ ‖direction e (vector t)-n‖ ≤ δ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.direction_smul_pos

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.badPiece_mass
statement:
lemma badPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) :
    (badPiece hr hh k p S n).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*4*badPrice h r k S n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.discounted_smallPiece_mass
statement:
lemma discounted_smallPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (i : ErrorIndex N k) :
    (smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).size^(1/100:ℝ)*(smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).mass ≤
      (scale r k)⁻¹*2*(rho^(k-i.1)*
        (rootWeight S k i.1 i.2.1*densityDefect N r (fun x => coordinate n (sign i.2.2) (h x)) i.1 i.2.1))

    rootSum h r k (goodRoots h r k S n) n y+rootSum h r k (badRoots h r k S n) n y = rootSum h r k S n y

    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))

    (smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*2*

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.smallPiece_pair_sum
statement:
lemma smallPiece_pair_sum {N : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N)) (n : ℂ) (j : Fin (k+1)) (q : Grid N) (X : ℂ) :
    (∑ b : Bool, (smallPiece hh hr k p S n (j,q,b)).density X) =
      rootWeight S k j q • rescale p (scale r k) (errorVector N r h j q n) X

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.cellPrice_budget
statement:
theorem cellPrice_budget {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (m : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∑ p ∈ P k, cellPrice N r h k (cellRoots N p)) ≤
      1681*((fixedPalette.labels.card:ℝ)*2/(1-rho))*(∫ y, ‖h y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.directional_cell_price
statement:
theorem directional_cell_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels → ∀ {s : ℝ}, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) →
    ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ X in Q, F X) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*(scale r k)⁻¹*
        (badPrice (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p) n+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ X, ‖X‖ ≤ 2 → ∀ t,
        NeighborhoodRadius (fun Y => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Y)) X t →
        ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (-inner ℝ (axis n s)
          (∫ Y in Metric.ball X t, gradient (fun Z => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Z)) Y))) ≤ F X

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.derivativeCost_spatial
statement:
lemma derivativeCost_spatial (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℤ × ℤ) (x y : ℂ) (i : ℕ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.filtered_spatial_cost
statement:
theorem filtered_spatial_cost (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ)
    (x y : ℂ) (j : ℕ) (hr : ∀ i ≤ j, 0 < r i)
    (hstep : ∀ i < j, r i = 2*r (i+1))
    (hx : ∀ i ≤ j, boxNorm (x-point (r i) (q i)) < 199*r i)
    (hy : ∀ i ≤ j, boxNorm (y-point (r i) (q i)) < 199*r i)
    (hdist : ‖x-y‖ ≤ 104*r j) :
    switchCost h r x j+derivativeCost h r x j ≤
      spatialConstant*filt (energyRate h r q y) j

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.marginal_spatial_distance

theorem marginal_spatial_distance (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ)
    (x y : ℂ) (j : ℕ) (hr : ∀ i ≤ j, 0 < r i)
    (hx : ∀ i ≤ j, boxNorm (x-point (r i) (q i)) < 199*r i)
    (hy : ∀ i ≤ j, boxNorm (y-point (r i) (q i)) < 199*r i) :
    l1dist (marginal h r j x) (marginal h r j y) ≤
      comparisonConstant*‖x-y‖*∑ i ∈ range (j+1), energyRate h r q y i/r i

theorem actual_signed_flux_bound (g : ℂ → ℝ) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)

    (hd : ∀ k n j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => observation h r k y n j) x)

    (hv : ∀ k t t', 0 < t → t ≤ 4*r k → 0 < t' → t' ≤ 4*r k →
      |DiskMoments.signedAverage g x t-DiskMoments.signedAverage g x t'| ≤ v k)

    |leafSum (fun q => inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => weight h r old y q) x) (potential g r x q)) m []| ≤

    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)

    (hinterior : ∀ k t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)

      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.SignedRuns.pointwise_signed_master
statement:
theorem pointwise_signed_master {g : ℂ → ℝ} (h : ℂ → ℂ) {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (old : Label) (m : ℕ) (x : ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    ‖gradient (runEnvelope g r 0 m) x‖ ≤ 12*(
      leafSum (fun q => weight h r old x q*divergence (fun y => potential g r y q) x) (m+1) []+
      (∑ k ∈ range (m+1), expect (marginal h r k x) (H k))+
      3*(∑ k ∈ range (m+1), boundaryCost h r x m k*J k))

lemma run_cone_bound {g : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (x : ℂ) (n : Label) (p : List Label)
    (hd : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => coneContribution a.dir (gradient (runEnvelope g r a.first a.last) x)).sum ≤
      divergence (fun y => potential g r y (n::p)) x+
      ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => J a.first).sum+
      ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => ∑ k ∈ Icc a.first a.last, H k a.dir).sum+
      2*((runs (n::p)).map fun a => J a.first+J a.last).sum

OAI.SignedDisk.SignedRuns.integrated_signed_master
statement:
theorem integrated_signed_master {g : ℂ → ℝ} (h : ℂ → ℂ) {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℂ → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ k n x, 0 ≤ H k n x) (hJ : ∀ k x, 0 ≤ J k x)
    (old : Label) (m : ℕ)
    (hinterior : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n x)
    (hend : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k x)
    (hvalue : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ k t t', 0 < t → t ≤ 4*r k → 0 < t' → t' ≤ 4*r k →
      |signedAverage g x t-signedAverage g x t'| ≤ r k*J k x)
    (hHi : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ n, Integrable (H k n))
    (hJi : ∀ k, k ≤ m → Integrable (J k)) :
    (∫ x, ‖gradient (runEnvelope g r 0 m) x‖) ≤
      12*((∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, expect (marginal h r k x) (fun n => H k n x))+
        4*(∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, pointCost h r x m k*J k x))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.patched_unfavorable
statement:
theorem patched_unfavorable : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {base R : ℝ} (hb : 0 < base) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/base+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) →
    ∃ H : ℕ → Label → ℂ → ℝ,
      (∀ j n x, 0 ≤ H j n x) ∧ (∀ j n, Integrable (H j n)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x, ∀ j n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale base j) x t →
        unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H j n x) ∧
      (∀ m n, (∑ j ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, marginal (gradient g) (geometricRadii base m) (m-j) x n*H j n x) ≤
        C*(∫ y, ‖gradient g y‖))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.physical_unfavorable_price
statement:
theorem physical_unfavorable_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (n : Label),
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ y in cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), F y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C*(badPrice (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p) n+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), ∀ t,
        PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale r k) y t →
        ENNReal.ofReal (unfavorable n (gradient (fun z => signedAverage g z t) y)) ≤ F y

    {base : ℝ} (hb : 0 < base) (m : ℕ)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℂ → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ j n x, 0 ≤ H j n x) (hJ : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ J j x)

    (hinterior : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ j n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale base j) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H j n x)
    (hend : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ j t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (scale base j) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J j x)
    (hvalue : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ j t t', 0 < t → t ≤ 4*scale base j → 0 < t' → t' ≤ 4*scale base j →
      |signedAverage g x t-signedAverage g x t'| ≤ scale base j*J j x) :
    (∫ x, ‖gradient (runEnvelope g (geometricRadii base m) 0 m) x‖) ≤
      12*((∑ j ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, expect (marginal (gradient g) (geometricRadii base m) (m-j) x) (fun n => H j n x))+
        4*(∑ j ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, pointCost (gradient g) (geometricRadii base m) x m (m-j)*J j x))
